reviews.name: Robin Otten
reviews.text:
I initially chose this massage shop because I checked the Google reviews beforehand, and they seemed quite positive. The place itself also looked nice when we arrived. I went together with my girlfriend, and the shop appeared clean, peaceful, and welcoming. We were offered tea at the beginning, which was a nice touch.

Unfortunately, the actual experience was very disappointing.

During roughly 30 minutes of our massage, there was constant noise throughout the shop. People were talking and shouting loudly, staff were talking outside, and customers were playing videos on their phones with the sound on. There are signs around the shop asking people to keep quiet, but nobody from the staff seemed to enforce this.

At one point, my girlfriend actually had to tell the people talking loudly to “shut up” herself before they finally stopped. Shortly afterwards, other people started talking loudly again. There was even a woman receiving a foot massage who was doomscrolling on her phone with the sound on, which I could hear throughout my entire massage.

For a massage shop, I find this especially disappointing. I expect a quiet and relaxing environment, and the staff should be the ones making sure customers respect that atmosphere.

The massage itself was also very disappointing. I specifically booked a back, neck and head massage for one hour, but during the entire hour, my head was touched for maybe three minutes in total, possibly even less. Meanwhile, approximately 20 minutes were spent massaging my arms. I honestly don’t understand why so much of the massage time was spent on my arms when I specifically booked a back, neck and head massage.

The actual technique also felt very poor. I didn’t feel that proper pressure points were being worked on, and there didn’t seem to be any consistent or effective massage technique. The pressure and movements felt random rather than like a proper massage. I left feeling like I may need to visit another massage shop just to properly work on my back after this experience.

Overall, the shop itself looks nice and the tea was a nice gesture, but the extremely noisy environment and poor quality of the massage completely ruined the experience for us.

Based on the Google reviews, I expected much more. Unfortunately, I would not return and cannot recommend this place based on my experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience with us did not meet your expectations.

We are especially sorry about the noise during your massage. We understand how important a quiet and relaxing atmosphere is, and we regret that our staff did not do enough to maintain that environment. We also apologize that the massage did not follow the treatment you requested, particularly regarding the time spent on your back, neck, and head. This is not the experience we want our guests to have.

We truly appreciate you bringing these concerns to our attention. We will discuss your feedback with our team and work on improving both our service and the atmosphere in the shop. We’re glad that you found the shop clean and welcoming, but we understand that these positive aspects cannot make up for the disappointing massage experience.

We are genuinely sorry, and we hope you may give us another opportunity in the future to provide the relaxing and professional experience you originally expected.🙇🏻‍♀️🙇🏻‍♀️

reviews.textTranslated: I went there because it was near my accommodation; it was a local neighborhood massage shop. The massage skills weren't bad, but they weren't outstanding either. I'm not sure if the price list outside was wrong, but they charged 500 baht for a one-hour oil massage (originally 400 baht). When I handed them 1,000 baht, they gave me 500 baht in change—I'm not sure if they didn't have any or if the price had gone up. Inside, there were about three massage beds, and when I went (around 9 PM), there were two masseuses. I was the only customer. Disposable underwear was not provided. You can't shower, and they just gave me a small bottle of water afterward. It wasn't the quality you'd expect for a 500-baht massage.

reviews.name: David Rock
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Mum Sabah Massage Salon for the past two years, and at this point I simply wouldn’t consider going anywhere else. What truly sets this place apart is the consistency and genuine quality of care.

In particular, I have been fortunate to find, in Khun O, quite possibly the best massage therapist I have ever experienced. She has an exceptional instinct for identifying exactly where tension and pain sit, and she works with remarkable precision on the areas that truly need attention. Every session feels tailored rather than routine, which is rare and deeply appreciated.

While her English is very limited, this has never been a barrier. Her skill, attentiveness, and intuitive understanding more than compensate for any language gap. In fact, it almost reinforces the sense that she communicates through her work rather than words.

The overall service is consistently excellent, the atmosphere calm and welcoming, and the professionalism evident in every visit. If you are looking for a place where genuine expertise meets heartfelt service, I can recommend Mum Sabah Massage Salon without hesitation.

ส่วนการนวดไม่ต้องพูดถึง นวดโดนแต่กระดูกจนเจ็บ ไม่รู้ว่าหมอนวดไม่เป็นหรือหมดแรง ตลอดเวลาที่นวดรู้สึกเหมือนแค่ขยำซ้ายที ขวาที ไม่มีจังหวะหรือเทคนิคอะไรเลย เหมือนนวดไปเรื่อย ๆ มากกว่า

เสียเงินไม่ว่า แต่เสียเวลามาก เซ็ง!!
reviews.textTranslated:
Today, I came for a massage with two friends, but after only 30 minutes, I had to ask the masseuse to stop because I couldn't continue. It felt like a huge waste of time.

From the moment we arrived, the masseuse started stepping on my legs without asking if I preferred a strong or light massage. She stepped on them so hard I cried out in pain. Shouldn't she have asked the client beforehand about their preferred pressure?

When I said I didn't want it too strong, she changed to such a light massage that it was almost nonexistent, like she was just playfully kneading my body.

I've had hundreds of massages in my life, and most masseuses have a sense of what a moderate pressure should be.

As for the massage itself, it was awful. She kept hitting the bones, causing pain. I don't know if she was inexperienced or just exhausted, but throughout the massage, it felt like she was just kneading left and right, without any rhythm or technique. It was more like she was just going on and on.

I don't mind the money, but I'm extremely disappointed and wasted so much time!

reviews.name: Stephan Tigges
reviews.text:
During my five-week stay in Chiang Mai, I regularly visited Siri Thai Massage – and without a doubt, it was one of the best decisions of my trip. I travel with chronic back problems and severe tension that usually make longer journeys very difficult. Already after my first visit, I realized that true professionals are at work here.

My therapist Nicha managed to individually address my special needs. The combination of one hour of oil massage and half an hour of Thai massage with targeted stretching was each time an experience that brought me noticeable relief. Her technique is excellent, and she truly understands how to adapt with great sensitivity, even to unusual circumstances.

The studio itself is inviting and very cozy. On the ground floor, you’ll find comfortable chairs for foot massages, where treatments begin. The atmosphere is friendly, relaxing, and always pleasantly air-conditioned. For longer sessions, you go upstairs to the first floor, where both traditional mats with curtains and massage tables are available. Everything is clean, discreet, and designed with a lot of care.

What I especially want to highlight is the warmth of the team: The owner and her family – above all Nicha and Gina – welcome every guest with kindness, friendliness, and a smile. Many times before my massage, I enjoyed sitting outside on the small bench with them, drinking water and chatting. This personal, family-like atmosphere makes Siri Thai Massage truly unique and sets it apart from many other studios.

After five weeks of daily treatments, I can say with full conviction: This is massage with heart and skill, offered at the highest level. If you are looking for a professional, effective, and at the same time incredibly pleasant massage in Chiang Mai, this is the perfect place.

ขั้นตอนค่อนข้างครบ ทั้งนวดศีรษะ นวดคอ บ่า ไหล่ นวดแขน มาส์กหน้า ประคบสมุนไพร และแช่เท้าด้วยเกลือหิมาลายัน ทำให้รู้สึกเหมือนได้ทำสปาแบบเต็มรูปแบบมากกว่าการสระผมทั่วไป จุดที่ชอบเป็นพิเศษคือการนวดศีรษะและการนวดอโรม่าบริเวณคอ บ่า ไหล่ ช่วยคลายความเมื่อยล้าได้ดีมาก

ผลิตภัณฑ์ที่ใช้เป็นออร์แกนิก กลิ่นหอมอ่อน ๆ ไม่ฉุน และปิดท้ายด้วยการเป่าผมด้วย Dyson AirStrait ทำให้ผมเรียบสวย ไม่ชี้ฟู

โดยรวมถือว่าคุ้มค่ากับราคา 890 บาท เหมาะสำหรับคนที่ต้องการพักผ่อน คลายความเครียด และดูแลทั้งหนังศีรษะ หน้าทคอ บ่า ไหล่ ในครั้งเดียว แนะนำให้ลองสักครั้งค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Premium Relaxing Hair Wash (1 hour 45 minutes) (890 THB) ⭐️ (I went during a promotion and got a 10% discount!)

I tried RIRAKKU's relaxing hair wash course and was impressed from the moment I arrived. The atmosphere was quiet, clean, and very relaxing. They used herbal oils and music therapy to create a comfortable feeling from the start of the treatment.

The process was quite comprehensive, including head, neck, shoulder, and arm massage, face mask, herbal compress, and Himalayan salt foot soak. It felt more like a full spa treatment than a regular hair wash. My favorite parts were the head massage and the aromatherapy massage on my neck, shoulders, and back – it was excellent for relieving fatigue.

The products used were organic, with a light, pleasant scent that wasn't overpowering. The treatment ended with a Dyson AirStrait blow-dry, leaving my hair smooth and frizz-free.

Overall, it's worth the 890 THB price. It's perfect for those who want to relax, relieve stress, and take care of their scalp, face, neck, and shoulders all in one go. I highly recommend trying it at least once.

reviews.text: Обожаю это место!!! Хожу сюда 3 раза в неделю,  давно не испытывала такого блаженства. После постоянного ношения ребёнка на руках моя спина уже забыла, что такое расслабление и жизнь без режима вареной креветки. Меня буквально поставили на место за два сеанса (тайский и расслабляющий массаж). Мастер сразу нашла мою проблемную зону и большую часть времени уделяла именно ей. Сейчас ничего не болит, и я просто наслаждаюсь отличным глубоким массажем! К какому бы мастеру я не попала, никто не разочаровал, здесь действительно все знают своё дело. Цены очень демократичные - такой результат стоит гораздо дороже. Тут нет атмосферы дорогого спа, но если вам важен результат, настоятельно рекомендую это место. Единственное, о чём жалею, что не пришла сюда раньше.
reviews.textTranslated: I adore this place!!! I come here three times a week and haven't felt such bliss in a long time. After constantly carrying my baby in my arms, my back has forgotten what relaxation and life without boiled shrimp are. I was literally put back in my place in two sessions (Thai and relaxing massage). The therapist immediately found my problem area and spent most of her time on it. Now nothing hurts, and I simply enjoy a wonderful deep massage! No matter which therapist I've seen, no one has disappointed me; everyone here truly knows their stuff. The prices are very reasonable – this kind of result is worth much more. It doesn't have the atmosphere of an expensive spa, but if results are important to you, I highly recommend this place. My only regret is that I didn't come here sooner.

reviews.text:
Это был лучший массаж, который нам делали в Тайланде. Мы приходили семьёй, мы с мужем были на массаже, ребёнок нас ожидал, внимание, добродушие и чуткость со стороны девушек к нашей семье. Обычно мы делали тайский массаж, но Дада посоветовала ойл массаж и это было нечто невероятное, окунулусь в атмосферу расслабления с элементами тайского массажа. Дада — невероятный мастер своего дела, знающий своё дело и невероятно добродушная, как и её коллега. Ойл массаж действительно расслабил, после него мы чувствовали себя прекрасно. Мы остались очень довольны! Полное расслабление, девушки стараются каждый раз, прорабатывают тщательно каждую зону. Очень рекомендуем!!!

При следующем посещении Пхукета, на массаж только к ним, номер телефона записала, поэтому будем на связи!
Удачи и успехов Дада❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
This was the best massage we've ever had in Thailand. We came with my family; my husband and I were there for a massage, our child was waiting for us, and the girls were so attentive, kind, and considerate of our family. We usually get Thai massages, but Dada recommended an oil massage, and it was incredible. I was immersed in a relaxing atmosphere with elements of Thai massage. Dada is an incredible professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly kind, just like her colleague. The oil massage was truly relaxing; we felt wonderful afterwards. We were very pleased! Total relaxation, the girls do their best every time, working meticulously on every area. Highly recommended!!!

Next time in Phuket, I'll only go to them for a massage. I've saved their phone number so we can keep in touch!
Good luck and success, Dada ❤️

reviews.text:
Puket tatiline gelip de masaj yaptirmamak olur mu hic deyip, ana kız otelin spa merkezinin yolunu tuttuk.
1 saat boyunca meshur Thai masajini denedik ama oncesinde guzel ve rahat bir cay yudumlarken kisa bir ayak masaji ile bizleri karsiladilar.Masaj sonrasinda da yine ayni nezaket ve guleryuzlulukle bu kez kucuk kurabiyelerle farkli bir cay ikrami daha gerceklestirdiler.
Biz cok memnun kaldik.
Bu arada eger spada masaj yaptirmak istemezseniz, kumsalda  12-15 kisinin yan yana ayni anda yatarak masaj hizmeti alabilecegi saati spanin dortte bir fiyatina da masaj cesitleri de mevcut. Biz onu da denedik ancak masaj benzer olsa da kisiye ozel, sessiz ve gurultusuz bir ahsap klimali kutuk evde masajin keyfi paha bicilemez👍🏼
reviews.textTranslated:
"It's impossible to come to Phuket for a holiday and not get a massage," my daughter and I said, heading to the hotel's spa center.
We spent an hour trying the famous Thai massage, but before that, they greeted us with a short foot massage while we sipped a nice, relaxing cup of tea. After the massage, with the same kindness and friendliness, they offered us another cup of tea with small cookies.
We were very pleased.
By the way, if you don't want a massage at the spa, there are also massage options available on the beach where 12-15 people can lie side-by-side and receive massage services at a quarter of the spa price per hour. We tried that too, but although the massage was similar, the pleasure of a private, quiet, air-conditioned wooden log cabin was priceless 👍🏼

reviews.text:
Часто хожу в эту массажку, мне прям очень нравятся несколько мастеров, но вчера был худший массаж в жизни (четверг 21 мая, примерно 19 часов, женщина лет 40, рыжые волосы, очки).
мне показалось что это не обученный сотрудник салоне, а какой-то садист с сексуальными наклоностями с улицы.

1) не выдали одежду, была голая, было очень холодно, кондиционер не убавили
2) до начала сеанса, я перевела через переводчик что хочу размять мышцы и не хрустеть суставами. первым делом женщина начала хрустеть позвоночником (ЭТО НЕБЕЗОПАСТНО)
3) Весь сеанс она сидела в TikTok. Зависала прямо во время массажа до минуты: схватала мою руку и замерала с ней. Иногда ей кто-то звонил и она длительно общалась по видео связи (очень приятно рядом лежать голой)
4) В какой-то момент она так сильно давила на шею, что было по-настоящему больно. Я сказала, что больно — она ответила «я знаю» и просто продолжила. ☠️☠️☠️
5) каждый раз когда я показывала на мышцы, что хочу получить их массаж, она зачем-то мне гладила попу
6) сеанс длился меньше 90 минут, но в данном случае я была рада, что худший сеанс закончился
7) ладошки не массажировали
8) гладила голову долго, без намеков на массаж (ранее я уже поняла что просить что-то бесползено, просто ждать)

Старый отзыв: щяс нереально кайфанула на тайском массаже с бальзамом за 400бат. но я приехала днём и застала мастера по имени мам куу
reviews.textTranslated:
I go to this massage parlor often, and I really like several of the therapists, but yesterday was the worst massage of my life (Thursday, May 21st, around 7 PM, woman in her 40s, red hair, glasses).
I felt like she wasn't a trained salon employee, but some sadist with sexual inclinations from the street.

1) They didn't give me clothes, I was naked, it was very cold, and they didn't turn down the air conditioning.
2) Before the session, I used a translator to translate that I wanted to stretch my muscles and not crack my joints. The first thing the woman did was crack her spine (THIS IS NOT SAFE).
3) She spent the entire session on TikTok. She was glued to it for up to a minute during the massage: she grabbed my hand and froze with it. Sometimes someone would call her and she'd have a long video chat (it was really nice to lie naked next to her).
4) At one point, she pressed so hard on my neck that it actually hurt. I said it hurt, and she said, "I know," and just kept going. ☠️☠️☠️
5) Every time I pointed to my muscles to massage, she'd stroke my butt for some reason.
6) The session lasted less than 90 minutes, but in this case, I was glad the worst session was over.
7) Her palms didn't massage.
8) She stroked my head for a long time, without any hint of a massage (I'd already learned that asking for anything is useless; just waiting).

reviews.name: Ксения Якунина
reviews.text: Обучалась в этой школе месяц, прошла все 5 уровней тайского массажа. Поначалу было сложно, больно и под конец учебного дня была усталость, но потом, твоё тело привыкает и тебе становится легче. Большое спасибо Мастеру Юки, преподаватель с большим стажем, мастер своего дела. Очень терпеливый и внимательный. Я занималась с ним индивидуально, так повезло, группа набралась на другой месяц. Мастер Юки терпеливо занимался со мной, ставил руку, следил за осанкой и последовательностью движений. Учебники выдаются с картинками и на 3-х языках. Если хотите изучить углублённые методы тайского массажа, то вам в эту школу. Так же хочу поблагодарить учителя Рину, которая обучала классическому тайскому массажу, базовый уровень. Рина очень улыбчивая, очень лёгкая, всё ясно объясняет. Всем рекомендую эту школу.
reviews.textTranslated: I studied at this school for a month and completed all 5 levels of Thai massage. It was difficult and painful at first, and I was tired by the end of the day, but then your body adjusts and it becomes easier. A huge thank you to Master Yuki, a highly experienced teacher and a master of his craft. He is very patient and attentive. I studied with him individually, and I was lucky; the group was formed for another month. Master Yuki patiently worked with me, carefully positioning my hand, monitoring my posture, and following the sequence of movements. The textbooks are provided with pictures and in three languages. If you want to learn more advanced Thai massage techniques, this is the school for you. I also want to thank teacher Rina, who taught the basic level of classical Thai massage. Rina is always smiling, very approachable, and explains everything clearly. I recommend this school to everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review. Please come back and study with us again anytime.

I usually come here for massages and have always felt that the service is worth the price. However, my most recent visit was disappointing.

During the session, my therapist suddenly left the room without saying anything. At first, I assumed she had gone to wash her hands before continuing with the body massage, but after waiting about 5–7 minutes, I became confused and concerned. I eventually opened the door and asked the receptionist what was going on. The receptionist then went to find the therapist.

When she returned, she explained that she had an upset stomach and continued the massage. However, the time she was away was not added back to my session, and the remainder of the massage felt rushed because the session was close to ending.

I understand that unexpected situations can happen, but the staff should take appropriate action in cases like this. Whether it’s extending the session time, arranging a replacement therapist, or offering a sincere apology, customers shouldn’t have to leave the shop feeling frustrated and dissatisfied with the experience.

I came for a massage on January 30th, 2026.

I walked in with a very tense back.
It felt like I was carrying the weight of the world all day and night.

But with just a touch from the therapist, everything started to relax.

No need to say much. If you've ever been massaged here,

Acupressure is an art, not just pressure.
That's why people keep coming back.

It's a treatment based on an understanding of pressure points.
If you have real pain, if you work hard,

reviews.text:
The massage service here truly delivers a genuine experience.

1. Space & Atmosphere
The first impression is the tranquil atmosphere, subtly scented with essential oils and warm yellow lighting. The room layout is well-designed, creating a sense of privacy and absolute relaxation.

2. Service Quality
Technician number 6 is very professional, performing precise movements and demonstrating a deep understanding of the client's body. Each massage and acupressure movement is performed smoothly, with the right pressure, and tailored to the client's needs (relaxation, pain relief for neck and shoulders, or improved blood circulation).

3. Results After the Experience
After about 60-90 minutes of massage, the body feels lighter, and the mind is noticeably relaxed. Back and shoulder pain is significantly reduced, and sleep is deeper and more restful afterward.

4. Pricing & Comparison
The service prices are slightly high. Compared to some other spas, the highlight here is the consistent skill level of the technicians and the stability of the service.

Conclusion
This is a reliable address for those who want to find a truly relaxing place, both for health care and to balance their energy after stressful work days.

ownerUpdates.text:
Sak Yant for Your Tok Sen & Gua Sha Tools

Give your tools a special connection to Thai tradition.

At CTM in Chiang Mai, a highly skilled Tok Sen tool maker applies Sak Yant—traditional sacred inscriptions—to your own tools. This service is available for Tok Sen and gua sha tools.

Prices:
• 3 tools: 500 THB
• Each additional tool: 200 THB

reviews.textTranslated:
I took a Thai massage course at Kaze no Mon Thai Traditional Massage with a friend on my first trip to Chiang Mai! Our stay was short, so we had to shorten the course time, but the instructor didn't just teach us the forms; they thoroughly explained the meaning of the practitioner's posture and what they were doing with each movement.

During the lesson, the instructor noticed that I was in a bad state and performed a massage for me.

The relief was incredibly fast…! It was truly amazing…!

I'm so glad I found this school and instructor!

It was so much fun I didn't want to leave! The senior students at the school were all so kind!

I'll definitely visit again when I have a longer stay in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: AKIMOTO RISA
reviews.text:
チェンマイ社長のケンさん。タイ伝統医療を知り尽くし、医師としての勉強もされているサーさん。器用に何でもできるノイさん。皆さんプロフェッショナルな上に、知識や技術だけではなく心を込めた熱心な指導をしてくださるので、本当に素敵な時間を過ごさせていただきました。
本物のタイ伝統医療を学びたい方にはおすすめのスクールです。
reviews.textTranslated:
Ken, the president of Chiang Mai; Sa, who is intimately familiar with traditional Thai medicine and is also studying to become a doctor; and Noi, who is incredibly skilled at everything—they are all professionals who not only possess knowledge and skills but also provide heartfelt and enthusiastic instruction, making for a truly wonderful experience.

I highly recommend this school to anyone who wants to learn authentic traditional Thai medicine.

reviews.name: kこうへい
reviews.text:
風の門と原初トークセンを受講しました。

座学はタイの歴史やマッサージの成り立ちからはじまり、タイ的な考え方と解剖学を合わせての説明でとてもわかりやすかったです。

実技では手順や形だけでなく、要所のポイントや効かせるコツ、自分の体を守る体制の作り方など細かく指導してもらえます。
また、症状別のアプローチはとても勉強になり、すぐにでも実戦で使える内容が盛りだくさんで早く施術に活かしたいと思いました。

チェンマイでは他のスクールにもいくつか通いましたが、ここまで濃い内容で学べたのは初めてです。
他のコースも受講しに戻ってきたいと思います。
reviews.textTranslated:
I took the "Gate of Wind" and "Primitive Tok Sen" courses.

The lectures began with Thai history and the origins of massage, and the explanations, combining Thai thinking with anatomy, were very easy to understand.

In the practical sessions, I received detailed instruction not only on procedures and forms, but also on key points, techniques for effectiveness, and how to protect my own body.

Furthermore, the symptom-specific approaches were very informative, and there was so much practical content that I wanted to immediately apply to my treatments.

I attended several other schools in Chiang Mai, but this was the first time I've learned such in-depth content.

I would like to come back and take other courses.

reviews.name: kaa ma
reviews.text:
1週間お世話になりました。座学も実技もとても分かりやすく丁寧に教えてもらいました！こんな感じかな？みたいな中途半端な動きはすぐ訂正してもらえ、分からないところは何度も出来るまでしっかりきめ細かく指導してもらえ、とても良かったです！
どこか不調のある方はサー先生の施術も受けてみてください。
ケンさんも楽しいお話をたくさんありがとうございました^ ^
またリテイクや別のコースでお世話になると思いますので、今後ともよろしくお願いします。
reviews.textTranslated:
Thank you for your guidance over the past week. Both the theoretical and practical lessons were taught very clearly and thoroughly! Any hesitant or uncertain movements were corrected immediately, and I received detailed and thorough instruction on anything I didn't understand until I got it right. It was excellent!

If you're experiencing any discomfort, I recommend trying Dr. Sir's treatment.

Thank you also, Ken, for all the enjoyable conversations!

I'm sure I'll be back for retakes or another course, so I look forward to working with you in the future.

実戦では、サーさんのお身体を借りながら、直接打ち方や強さなどを細かく教えてもらえたのも勉強になりました！

次はレベル3を受けにCTMに再度行きたいと思います！
トークセン学びたい方には、個人的にとってもおすすめです！

※お昼には美味しいご飯屋さんも教えてもらえます😋
reviews.textTranslated:
I went to learn the original Tok Sen in January!
Level 1 was self-care.
Level 2 was full-body Tok Sen. What is Tok Sen? It started with a lecture and then moved on to practical application. It was easy to understand for me, and it was great that I could ask about anything I didn't understand!

During the actual practice, I was able to use Sir's body to learn detailed instructions on how to strike and how strong to strike, which was also very educational!

Next, I'd like to go back to CTM for Level 3!
I personally highly recommend it for anyone wanting to learn Tok Sen!

※You can also get recommendations for delicious restaurants for lunch.😋

reviews.name: Debbie Bunzl
reviews.text:
ประทับใจ RLAX Chiang Mai Home Massage Spa มากค่ะ 💆‍♀️✨

ครั้งนี้เลือกแพ็กเกจ **Revive & Relax 2 ชั่วโมง** เป็นนวดน้ำมันอโรม่า + ทรีตเมนต์หน้า + นวดศีรษะ ผ่อนคลายมากๆ เลยค่ะ

ที่ชอบที่สุดคือสามารถเรียกให้มานวดถึงที่พักได้ พอดีมาคนเดียวกับลูกสาว และลูกสาวไม่อยากไปสปาด้วย เลยไม่ค่อยสะดวกออกไปไหน การนวดถึงที่พักเลยตอบโจทย์มาก ไม่ต้องกังวลเรื่องดูแลลูกด้วย

พนักงานนวดใจดี สุภาพ และเป็นกันเองมากค่ะ ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจตลอดการนวด นวดได้ดีและผ่อนคลายมาก ส่วนทรีตเมนต์หน้าก็ชอบมาก รู้สึกสดชื่นและผิวดูดีขึ้นหลังทำค่ะ

โดยรวมประทับใจมาก ทั้งสะดวกและบริการดี ถ้าใครพักอยู่เชียงใหม่และอยากนวดแบบไม่ต้องออกจากที่พัก แนะนำเลยค่ะ ❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
I was very impressed with RLAX Chiang Mai Home Massage Spa 💆‍♀️✨

This time I chose the **Revive & Relax 2-hour package**, which included an aromatherapy oil massage, facial treatment, and head massage. It was incredibly relaxing!

What I liked most was the ability to have the massage done at my accommodation. I was traveling alone with my daughter, and she didn't want to go to a spa, so it wasn't convenient to go out. The in-home massage was perfect, and I didn't have to worry about looking after my daughter.

The massage therapists were kind, polite, and very friendly, making me feel comfortable throughout the massage. The massage was excellent and very relaxing. I also loved the facial treatment; my skin felt refreshed and looked better afterward.

Overall, I was very impressed. It was convenient and the service was great. If you're staying in Chiang Mai and want a massage without having to leave your accommodation, I highly recommend it! ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
สวัสดีค่ะ คุณ Debbie

RLAX ขอขอบคุณที่เลือกใช้บริการและสละเวลาแชร์ประสบการณ์ดี ๆ ให้กับเราค่ะ 🧡 เรายินดีเป็นอย่างยิ่งที่บริการของเราตอบโจทย์กับไลฟ์สไตล์ ทำให้คุณไม่ต้องเดินทางออกไปรับบริการนวดข้างนอก และได้ใช้เวลาอยู่กับลูกค่ะ 

ทางทีมงานหวังว่าจะได้มีโอกาสดูแลคุณอีกครั้งในเร็วๆ นี้ค่ะ
Ploy, Customer Support

reviews.name: Liu Xi
reviews.text: Be careful of the masseuse, when a massage is done incorrectly, it can cause dangerous injuries for your body. I had two hours Thai oil massage, the masseuse massaged me like she hated me, I was in so much pain during the massage and told her please be gentle. About 24 hours later, I have bruises on my left leg, and my right foot is in a lot pain and can’t walk properly. This is a truly a massage gone wrong. :(
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Liu Xi, we're very sorry to hear about your experience and the pain you've been experiencing after your massage. This is certainly not the standard of care we strive to provide.

We take your feedback very seriously. Our team will investigate this matter with the service provider and review the details of your appointment. We will also contact you directly to update you on the progress of our investigation as soon as possible.

We sincerely apologize that this happened, and thank you for bringing it to our attention. We appreciate your patience while we look into this matter, and we're committed to resolving it as thoroughly and promptly as possible.

Ploy, Customer Support

3 - 5 - 7 - 14 - 30 วัน

2. ปรับสมดุลย์และล้างพิษในร่างกายด้วยอาหารและเครื่องดื่มเพื่อสุขภาพ

4. นวดบำบัดฟื้นฟูสุขภาพขั้นสูงพร้อมแก้ไขตามลำดับการคลายร่างกาย

5. แช่น้ำแร่ร้อน และ น้ำแร่แมกนีเซียม เพื่อใช้บำบัดร่วม กับการนวดฟื้นฟูร่างกาย
เหตุผล + ทำได้จริง = สำเร็จ
“พลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่ มาพร้อมกับความรับผิดชอบที่ใหญ่ยิ่ง” (With great power comes great responsibility)

ยาที่ทานแล้ว "ถูกโรค" หรือ ทำให้หายดีได้แน่นอน ต้องเห็นผลได้ตั้งแต่ครั้งแรก และ สังเกตได้

อย่างเช่น ตาเหลืองจนเขียว ทานยาตัวนี้เข้าไปครั้งแรก ก่อนนอน

ตอนเช้า ตื่นนอนมา สังเกตเห็น สีลูกตาลดลง หายเขียว เหลืองก้อลดจางลง แบบเห็นได้ชัด อาการที่เป็นอยู่ทั้งหมดทุเลาเบาบางลงชัดเจน อย่างนี้เป็นต้นครับ (จากประสบการณ์จริงของตัวเองครับ)

การนวด ทะลวง ปรับ เส้นเลือดลมการโคจรใหม่ ของร่างกาย จึงเป็นทางเลือก และ ทางรอด ของผู้ที่ทานยาไปแล้วไม่ได้ผลครับ หรือ เส้นแห้งลีบจนฉีดยาไม่ได้แล้ว หรือ ...

เหมาะสำหรับพวก ผู้ที่ลองยามาหมดแล้วทุกขนาน แล้วยังไม่ได้ผล

หรือ รู้สึกท้อ ว่าเสียเวลากับยาแพงๆ มามากเกินไปแล้ว และ ยังไม่ได้คำตอบ ...

ก้อ ขอเชิญค้นหา คำตอบ ได้ ในเพจนี้ ...

ซึ่ง ผมได้ทำการรวบรวมองค์ความรู้เรื่องพวกนี้ จากประสบการณ์จริง อธิบายชัดเจนเข้าใจง่าย และค่อนข้างครบถ้วนแล้วครับ

แต่ติดตรงที่ว่าข้อมูลอาจจะละเอียดเกินไปเสียหน่อย เพราะเป็นประสบการณ์ตรงจากความเข้าใจของผู้เชี่ยวชาญ

เพจนี้ จะเป็นการเปิดองค์ความรู้ใหม่ นอกกรอบ ที่ควนส่วนมากยังเข้าไม่ถึงกัน ซึ่ง ส่วนมากยังพลิกฟื้นสุขภาพ กันยังไม่ได้ครับ

ขอบคุณที่ให้ความสนใจครับ โชคดีครับ

เพจ หมอโบราณ แก้เส้น และ ธรรมชาติบำบัดฟื้นฟู เชียงใหม่

ยาไปตามเส้นทางการไหลเวียนเลือดลม ถ้าหนีบ ถ้าลีบ ถ้าอัด หรือ ล็อก ติดขัด จนเป็นพังผืด หรือ ติดขัง น้ำเหลืองเสีย หรือ ภาวะเซลลูไลต์ ซึ่งถือว่าเป็นตระกูลเดียวกับพังผืด

ยาดีแค่ไหนมันก้อจะกลายเป็นภาระของร่าง เพราะจุดดูดซึม ดูดซึมไม่ได้

แถม ส่งสารอาหารไปเลี้ยงไม่ได้ ไม่พอ กลับแต่ กลายมาเป็นภาระของ ตับ ไต ต้องมาทำหน้าที่ขับยาทิ้งอีกครับ ซึ่งไม่เกี่ยวเลย ว่าจะเป็นยาดี หรือ ยาไม่ดี 

แต่เพียงเพราะเส้นเลือดการโคจรอุดตัน ส่งผลให้สารอาหาร ไม่สามารถส่งผ่านจากเลือด ไปส่งถึงส่วนหรืออวัยวะของร่างกายที่ต้องการซ่อมแซม หรือ มากกว่านั้นคือไม่พอกระตุ้นให้ร่างกายเกิดการฟื้นฟูตนเองได้

ถ้าเป็นยาดีก้อให้ผลน้อยมาก แต่โดนขับทิ้งออกเสียมากกว่า เสียดายยา เสียดายของครับ เป็นการสิ้นเปลืองโดยใช่เหตุ

" หัวใจหลัก ของ แพทย์แผนไทย อยู่ที่ เลือด ลม "

เพราะฉะนั้น เลือด ก้อควรจะล้างปรับให้ถูกวิธีก่อน และตามด้วย การคุมอาหารให้ถูกวิธี ไม่เอาพิษเข้าร่างก่อน เป็นหลัก

ขออนุญาตแชร์ประสบการณ์นะคะ

พอดีมาพักที่โรงแรมสิรินครพิงค์ เลยเสิชหาหมอนวดที่ใกล้โรงแรม เห็นว่าทางหมอนวดเปิดบริการ24ชม จึงโทรติดต่อให้มานวดที่โรงแรม

ราคา 500/ชม. ครึ่ง ชม 300

เบื้องต้นแจ้งอาการว่าปวดหลังสะโพกร้าวลงขา และปวดตึงทั่วตัว ทางหมอนวดเริ่มต้นโดยการให้ดื่มน้ำผสมเบกกิ้งโซดาที่หมอนวดเตรียมมา และเริ่มบรรยาถึงวิธีการทานอาหาร และข้อมูลศาสนาพวกเวรกรรม โชคลาภ ต่างๆ ซี่งทางเราไม่ได้เชื่อ จึงขอให้นวดเลย

หมอนวดแจ้งว่าช่วงบ่าตึงมาก และถามว่าปวดฝั่งไหนมากกว่า เลยแจ้งหมอนวดไปว่าปวดฝั่งขวามากกว่า หลังจากนั้นหมอนวดเลยเริ่มนวดที่แขนซ้าย จนครบ 1 ชม เป็นการนวดแขนซ้ายและไหล่ซ้ายเพียงจุดเดียว  ซึ่งเป็นการนวดค่อนข้างแปลกและเจ็บมาก ไม่เคยเจอที่ไหนนนวดแขนอย่างเดียวทั้งชั่วโมง แต่เนื่องจากปกติเป็นคนนวดหนักได้ เลยลองทนไปดูก่อน เผื่อจะดีขึ้น เริ่มชั่วโมงที่สอง ก็ยังคงนวดที่แขนซ้ายและไหล่ซ้ายตามเดิม แต่อาการปวดระบมเยอะขึ้น เริ่มรู้สึกร้อนและชาที่แขน จึงแจ้งให้หมอนวดทราบ แต่วิธีการนวดก็ยังคงกดเจ็บในจุดเดิม จนทนไม่ได้จึงแจ้งให้หยุดนวด

โดยรวม เสียค่าบริการ 800 บาท จากเดิมปวดช่วงหลัง สะโพก ขา หลังนวดเสร็จจุดที่ปวดไม่ได้รับการนวด และมีการปวดแขนและไหล่ซ้ายเพิ่มขึ้น อาการหลังตื่นนอน ไหล่ซ้ายอักเสบ บวมแดง ยกแขนไม่ขึ้น หลังนวดเสร็จประมาณ10นาที เกิดรอยบวมแดงที่หัวไหล่ เช้ามาอาการปวดบวมมากขึ้นและเกิดรอยจ้ำตามแขน มีอาการชาเป็นพักๆ คงต้องไปโรงพยาบาลเพื่อรักษาต่อไป

หวังว่าผู้ใช้บริการท่านอื่นๆอาจได้ประโยชน์จากรีวิวนี้นะคะ

Note: ทางหมอนวดอ้างว่ารู้จักและเคยมานวดให้เจ้าของโรงแรมสิรินครพิงค์ เพราะเป็นสโตก  แต่เราเช็คกับทางเจ้าของแล้ว เจ้าของแจ้งว่าไม่เคยเห็นและไม่รู้จัก
reviews.textTranslated:
Allow me to share my experience.

I was staying at the Sirindhornping Hotel and searched for a massage therapist near the hotel. I saw that this therapist offered 24-hour service, so I called to arrange a massage at the hotel.

The price was 500 baht per hour, or 300 baht for half an hour.

I initially described my symptoms as back and hip pain radiating down my legs, and general body stiffness. The massage therapist started by having me drink water mixed with baking soda that they had prepared. They then began discussing dietary guidelines and religious concepts like karma and luck, which I don't believe in, so I asked them to proceed with the massage.

The massage therapist noticed my shoulders were very tense and asked which side was more painful. I told them my right side was more painful. After that, they began massaging my left arm. For a full hour, they massaged only my left arm and shoulder. This was quite unusual and very painful; I've never encountered a massage where the arm was massaged alone for an entire hour. However, since I usually can handle strong pressure during massages, I endured it, hoping it would improve. In the second hour, they continued massaging my left arm and shoulder, but the pain and bruising worsened. I started to feel heat and numbness in my arm, so I informed the massage therapist. However, the massage continued to press on the same painful spots, to the point where I couldn't bear it anymore and asked them to stop.

Overall, I paid 800 baht. Initially, I had pain in my back, hips, and legs. After the massage, the painful spots weren't massaged, and I experienced increased pain in my left arm and shoulder. Upon waking up, my left shoulder was inflamed, swollen, red, and I couldn't lift my arm. About 10 minutes after the massage, a red, swollen mark appeared on my shoulder. The next morning, the pain and swelling worsened, and I developed bruises on my arm with intermittent numbness. I will likely need to go to the hospital for treatment.

Hopefully, other clients may find this review helpful.

Note: The masseuse claimed to know and had previously massaged the owner of the Sirinakhonping Hotel who had a stroke. However, we checked with the owner, who stated they had never seen or known her.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ภาวะเกิดการ "เปิดระบบซ่อมแซมร่างกายที่เป็นพังผืดทั้งร่างอย่างรุนแรง"

อาการนี้เกิดจากการนวดผิดวิธีบ่อยครั้ง และ นวดหนักมาเป็นเวลานาน 

หากสามารถนวดแก้ไขฟื้นฟูร่างกายได้จริง จะทำให้เกิดอาการไม่พึงประสงค์หลังนวด
 แต่จะไม่ปรากฏโดยทันที หากแต่จะ ปรากฏเมื่อยามตื่นนอน
 เพราะเมื่อยามนอน จะเกิดการไหลเวียนเลือดผ่านสมอง และ เชื่อมระบบเส้นประสาทจากสมองไปยังพื้นที่ที่ทำการเปิดระบบร่างกายให้ไหลเวียน

การนวดที่สามารถเชื่อมเส้นประสาทได้จริงจะทำให้ร่างกายแสดงอาการที่แท้จริงออกมา และ สมองจะสั่งให้ทำการซ่อมแซมและรักษาร่างกายได้ตามความเป็นจริง และ ท้ายที่สุดจะทำให้อาการรุนแรงที่เป็นอยู่ดีขึ้นจริง

1. หากมีการนวดจนเชื่อมระบบเส้นสมองได้จริงไปถึงส่วนที่มีปัญหา จะทำให้ระบบประสาทกลับคืน แล้วแสดงอาการที่แท้จริงออกมา
หากร่างกายขาดเลือด จะทำให้รู้ตัวว่า ตัวเองเกิดอาการ ชา ขึ้นมา
 และ หากมีรอย ช้ำ ปรากฎขึ้น นั่นแสดงว่า ส่วนนั้นเลือดลมไม่ไหลเวียน ต้องทำการนวดจนเลือดลมโคจรไหลเวียนทั้งหมดรอยช้ำจะหายไป ทั้งนี้ต้องพิจารณาร่างกายของผู้ถูกนวดด้วย ว่า สามารถทำได้เลยมั้ย หรือ ต้องใช้เวลากี่ครั้ง (หากอาการหนักมาก หากนวดจนเชื่อมเส้นวงจรการโคจรของเลือดทั้งหมดได้แล้ว จะทำให้ รอยช้ำ หายไปทันที)

2. การนวดหนักและนวดบ่อย
ความจริง แล้ว ยิ่งนวดยิ่งปวด เกิดจากการนวดหนักและผิดวิธี เลือดไม่ได้ไหลเวียนซ่อมร่างกายจริง แต่นวดผิดวิธีทั้งหนักและแรง จนเกิดเป็นพังผืด
 เพราะยามที่ร่างกายบาดเจ็บ ร่างกายจะส่ง tissue หรือ เนื้อเยื่อ เข้ามาซ่อมตรงที่บาดเจ็บ ทำให้เกิดพอกหนาเป็นพังผืด
 และเมื่อนวดผิดวิธีไปเรื่อยๆ จะทำให้พังผืดพอกหนาขึ้น และปวดหนักขึ้น
 ทำให้ เมื่อ ยิ่งนวด อาการยิ่งหนักขึ้น แทนที่จะเบาลง

วิธีแก้ร่างกายที่อาการหนักรุนแรง เช่น ภาวะที่เป็นพังผืดทั้งร่างต้อง...

1. นวดแก้ไข 1 ส่วนของร่างกายในครั้งแรกให้ได้ก่อน เช่น แขนข้างที่พอเปิดระบบได้ หรือ ขา ที่พอเปิดระบบได้ ให้เกิดการไหลเวียนได้จริง ซึ่งตามแต่ร่างกายของผู้ถูกนวดจะสามารถทำการแก้ไขได้ ทั้งนี้ขึ้นอยู่กับการวินิจฉัยของผู้นวด

หากเปิดระบบ ทำให้ร่างกายเกิดการฟื้นฟู ได้จริง สำหรับคนที่มีอาการหนักมาก อาจทำให้เกิดอาการไม่พึงประสงค์เหล่านี้ และ เมื่อเวลาผ่านไป จะทำให้เลือดลมไหลเวียนในร่างกายจนเกิดการ ซ่อมแซม และ ฟื้นฟู ตัวเอง ได้อย่างแท้จริง

This is a place where a master, legendary artisan, a GOAT—going beyond the level of an expert—is present.

My jaw, which had shifted due to malocclusion, has returned to its original state.

My height, which had diminished, has returned.

I have seen heaven.

I highly recommend this place; you must experience it quickly before your remaining travel days dwindle.

I am someone who doesn't even leave reviews for delicious restaurants, but I am leaving one here.

I resent myself for only discovering this now.

I simply understand why there are so many compliments in the comments.

reviews.name: Byungjoo Kang
reviews.text:
깔끔한 시설  그러나 마사지사 관리는 미흡

헤드  쇼더 한 시간 받았어요.

1. 손가락 압이 많이 약해요. 중간중간 쓰다듬는 수준

2. 체계적이지 못한 순서. 맛사지 받다 앉히고 팔잡고 땡기고 다시 한 참 주무르다  또
팔잡고 땡기고. 관절 꺽는 자세들도 몰라서 허둥댔어요. 20분은 앉아서 받은듯.

3. 손이 더러웠어요. 끈적거리고 기분 나빴어요.

좋았던 점:
1.전체적인 시설이 깔끔했어요.
------------------------------------

관리가 잘 되는 맛사지 샵에서 같은 코스로 둘이 옆에서 같이 받으면 같은 부위를 거의 같은 시간동안 주무르는걸 볼 수 있어요. 다음 날  혼자가서 같은  메뉴코스로 받으면 마사지사가 바뀌어도 어제 순서와 비슷합니다. 메뉴마다 마사지 순서 플로우차트가 어느정도 있다는거죠.
그러나 이 곳은 각 마사지사 재량껏 복걸복이네요.
좀 많이 아쉽네요.
reviews.textTranslated:
Clean facilities, but poor management of the masseurs.

I received a one-hour head shoulder massage.

1. The pressure from the fingers was very weak. It was more like stroking in between.

2. The sequence was unsystematic. They would make me sit down while I was getting a massage, grab my arm and pull it, then knead it for a while, and then grab my arm and pull it again. They didn't know the joint-bending positions and fumbled around. It felt like I was sitting for about 20 minutes.

3. Their hands were dirty. They were sticky and unpleasant.

Pros:

1. The overall facilities were clean.

------------------------------------

In a well-managed massage shop, if two people receive the same course next to each other, you can see that the same areas are being massaged for almost the same amount of time. If you go alone the next day and receive the same menu course, even if the masseur changes, the sequence is similar to yesterday's. This implies that there is a flowchart for the massage sequence for each menu item to some extent.

However, here, it is a matter of luck depending on the masseur's discretion.

It is quite disappointing.

reviews.name: Cora Esser
reviews.text:
Ich hätte die Massage am liebsten zwischendurch abgebrochen. Sehr schmerzhaft, überall rumgedrückt außer auf Muskeln. Nachdem ich angesprochen habe, dass es sehr wehtut, hat sie mit ihrer Kollegin über mich gelacht und irgendwas auf thailändisch gesagt. Während der gesamten Massage haben beide Mitarbeiterinnen geredet. Das war nicht entspannen. Aus dem Vorraum hat man die ganze Zeit TikTok Sounds gehört und weitere Mitarbeiter die echt laut geredet haben.
Die Vorhänge, Kissen, decken, Handtücher, usw. Haben alle sehr unangenehm gerochen, nach Schimmel und muffig alt, als wäre noch nie etwas gewaschen worden.
Die Toilette war sehr eklig und dreckig.

Es tut irgendwie weh, dafür Geld ausgegeben zu haben. Während der Massage habe ich mehrfach überlegt diese abzubrechen.

Mit Abstand die schlechteste Thai Massage in Thailand die ich seitdem ich hier bin hatte.
Was mich sehr traurig macht, weil ich nach den bisherigen Bewertungen mehr erwartet habe!
reviews.textTranslated:
I almost stopped the massage halfway through. It was very painful; they pressed everywhere except on my muscles. After I mentioned how much it hurt, she and her colleague laughed at me and said something in Thai. Both women talked the entire time. It wasn't relaxing at all. You could hear TikTok music and other employees talking really loudly from the waiting room the whole time.

The curtains, pillows, blankets, towels, etc., all smelled very unpleasant—moldy and musty, as if nothing had ever been washed.

The toilet was disgusting and dirty.

It's painful to have spent money on this. I considered ending the massage several times during it.

By far the worst Thai massage I've had in Thailand since I've been here.

Which makes me very sad because I expected more based on the previous reviews!

reviews.name: Rob
reviews.text: I had the best Thai massage in my life there, no joking. When I first walked by the temple and saw this small massage salon inside, I bookmarked it for later. Then I asked the guide of a tour we had another day about his personal favorite massage salon in Chiang Mai and he recommended me exactly this one. So I definitely had to go and I couldn’t be happier. Be prepared for a wait time, I had to come back an hour later, but it was worth waiting, because Mr. Chai, the masseur that I got, was very experienced, and within that 1.5h he did a fantastic job on legs, arms, neck, shoulder and back. I came back to the hotel like reborn and super relaxed. There might be other good locations out there, but when a massage salon is within a temple, I guess you’re in good hands! I’ll definitely come back next time I visit Chiang Mai. Sadly I discovered this gem too late and I’m already leaving tomorrow. Would have loved to go there a second time. Side note: don’t expect a fancy location or special SPA treatments like offered on the main roads. It’s a honest, very down to earth and very lovely place with experienced people doing an amazing job!

Le meilleur massage thaï que j'ai pû recevoir jusque là, Wandee est comme votre grande mère, bienveillante. J'avais pris 1h thaï et au final en ressentant ses compétences j'en est pris 2h au total et sans hésiter plus longtemps.

Merci pour tout Wandee, j'espère pouvoir revenir vous voir.
reviews.textTranslated:
The best Thai massage I've ever had! Wandee is like a grandmother to you—so caring. I booked a one-hour Thai massage, but after experiencing her skill, I ended up booking a two-hour session and wouldn't have hesitated to stay longer.
Wandee is a true healer and tailors the massage to your specific aches and pains.
Thank you so much, Wandee. I hope to come back and see you again.

reviews.name: Hamarat Ellerim Henna
reviews.text:
Wandee'yi Google yorumlarda buldum. Kendisine ulaşmak için telefon etmeniz yada direk gitmeniz gerekiyor 😅
Orada bir öğrencisi yardımı ile iletişime geçtim, 5 gün başka bir okulda eğitim aldıktan sonra daha rahat bir eğitim istediğim için Wandee yi tercih ettim.
Uzun yılların tecrübesi olan, alternatif tıp uygulamaları ile hastalıklarını dokunarak bulan bir doktor. Omurga ve kalçamdaki sorunları tedavi etti, sonrasında karın ağrıma iyi gelecek birşeyler yaptı, elleri çok şifalı gerçekten 🥹😍❤️ Çok teşekkür ediyorum ve duacıyım kendisine.. 🤲🏻

İngilizce pek iyi olmasa da translate ile konuşarak herşeyi anlatıyor, sorun yaşamadık. Çok komik ve guleryuzlu anlayışlı bir hoca ☺️
Keşke daha uzun vaktim olsaydı onunla zaman geçirmek için, bana büyükannem gibi davrandı, yemeklerini paylaşti, meyve hazirladı..
Geleneksel Thai aile ortamı görme şansım oldu, orada 5 gün üst kattaki hostelinde kaldım. Tek kişilik oda 250 baht çok uygundu orada kalmayı tercih ettim.

Wandee den hem yağlı masaj, hemde refleksoloji masajı eğitimi aldım, istediğim günlerde bana zaman ayırdı serbest çalistik. Detayli uygulamalı gösteriyor, birebir eğitim aldim. Ayakta dokunduğu yerlerde ne sorununuz var anlayabiliyor, umarım bir gün bende onun gibi olabilirim.. 😌

Yeniden görüşmek üzere Wandee anneanne seni özleyeceğim..🙏🏻☺️❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
I found Wandee through Google reviews. To reach her, you either have to call or go in person 😅
I contacted her through one of her students. After attending another school for 5 days, I chose Wandee because I wanted a more relaxed learning environment.
She's a doctor with many years of experience, using alternative medicine practices to diagnose illnesses through touch. She treated my spine and hip problems, and then did something to help with my stomach ache. Her hands are truly healing 🥹😍❤️ I thank her very much and I pray for her.. 🤲🏻

Although her English wasn't very good, she explained everything using translation, so we didn't have any problems. She's a very funny, cheerful, and understanding teacher ☺️
I wish I had more time to spend with her. She treated me like my grandmother, shared her meals, and prepared fruit for me.
I had the chance to experience a traditional Thai family environment. I stayed in her hostel upstairs for 5 days. A single room was very affordable at 250 baht, so I chose to stay there.

I received training in both oil massage and reflexology massage from Wandee. She made time for me on the days I wanted, and we worked independently. She demonstrates in detail, and I received one-on-one training. She can understand what problems you have just by touching your feet. I hope I can be like her someday... 😌

See you again, Grandma Wandee, I will miss you... 🙏🏻☺️❤️

reviews.name: ivana martinez
reviews.text:
learning thai massage, foot massage and other different types as therapy and oil massage was one of the best experiences i’ve ever had in my life.
she’s a great person and a good teacher, she has so much knowledge to share with her students and takes the time to do it, of course there are some difficulties with the language barrier but she always find a way to explain herself well. And one of the most important things she teaches.. is about practice, she encourages her students to practice on clients when they come in, because she wants to teach also confidence and she just does this when she sees the student is ready for his first client.. or sometimes just for practice.😅😂
i appreciate so much to haver her as my teacher and guide. definitely i will comeback to learn more from her! yay wandee! thank you!!!

reviews.name: Alma
reviews.text:
I stayed at Wandee’s house for eight days to learn Thai and oil massage.

Wandee is not only a skilled massage therapist and instructor but also knowledgeable in traditional medicine and pharmacy. When she touches your pressure points, she can sense your health conditions.

After eight days of study, I’ve developed a deeper appreciation for the human body and feel more professional in my massage practice, thanks to the hands-on training Wandee provided.

Her husband and friends are also kind and welcoming. I’m grateful for their warm hearts and help.

reviews.text:
ประทับใจมากค่ะ ❤️

มาที่ร้านเพื่อตัดผมตามรูป Reference และทำ Deep Sleep Massage ผลลัพธ์เกินคาดเลยค่ะ

ช่างตัดผมออกมาตรงกับเรฟที่ให้มาก เข้าใจความต้องการและเก็บรายละเอียดดีมาก ทรงออกมาดูเป็นธรรมชาติ จัดทรงง่าย ถูกใจสุด ๆ 😊

ส่วน Deep Sleep Massage คือดีมาก รู้สึกผ่อนคลายทั้งตัว โดยเฉพาะช่วงคอ บ่า ไหล่ หลังนวดรู้สึกสบายมาก และคืนนั้นนอนหลับสนิท ตื่นมาสดชื่น ทั้งที่ปกติเป็นคนมีไมเกรนและนอนหลับไม่ค่อยดี

พนักงานบริการดี บรรยากาศร้านสะอาด น่านั่ง และใส่ใจลูกค้า

ถ้าใครกำลังหาร้านตัดผมที่ตัดตามเรฟได้จริง และอยากผ่อนคลาย แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ ไว้มีโอกาสจะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน 🥰
reviews.textTranslated:
I was very impressed ❤️

I came to the salon for a haircut based on a reference picture and a Deep Sleep Massage. The results exceeded my expectations!

The hairstylist cut my hair exactly as per the reference I provided. They understood my needs and paid great attention to detail. The style looks natural, is easy to style, and I'm absolutely delighted 😊

The Deep Sleep Massage was amazing. I felt relaxed all over, especially my neck, shoulders, and upper back. I felt so comfortable after the massage and slept soundly that night. I woke up feeling refreshed, even though I usually suffer from migraines and have trouble sleeping.

The staff provided excellent service, the salon was clean and inviting, and they were very attentive to customers.

If you're looking for a salon that can accurately cut your hair according to a reference picture and also want to relax, I highly recommend this place. I will definitely be back for more services 🥰

Today I had a massage with P' Ja. Before coming, I saw some negative reviews and hesitated, but I decided to give it a try. I would have regretted it if I hadn't come today. From what I understand from P' Ja, there's a new person in charge. Come get a massage here; you won't be disappointed! (This is a genuine review, not biased.) Wishing you great success! 🤍

reviews.name: Gabriela Reiko
reviews.text:
バンコク旅行でたくさん歩いて、気づかないうちに身体も心もかなり疲れていたのですが、最後に訪れたVie Spaで本当に癒されました。

高級感のある落ち着いた空間で、お部屋もとても清潔で美しく、入った瞬間から特別な時間が始まるような雰囲気。スタッフの方々の対応も終始丁寧で、一つひとつの気遣いが心地よかったです。

施術も絶妙な力加減で、旅の疲れで重たかった肩や脚がすっきり軽くなり、終わる頃には身体だけでなく気持ちまでリフレッシュできました。

バンコク旅行の締めくくりにぴったりの贅沢な癒しの時間。またバンコクを訪れた際には、ぜひ戻ってきたいと思える素敵なスパでした。
reviews.textTranslated:
I walked a lot during my trip to Bangkok, and without realizing it, my body and mind were quite tired. But I truly felt refreshed at Vie Spa, my last stop.

The luxurious and tranquil atmosphere, the clean and beautiful rooms, and the feeling that a special time was beginning the moment I stepped inside—it was all so relaxing. The staff were consistently attentive and their thoughtful touches were incredibly pleasant.

The treatment was performed with just the right amount of pressure; my shoulders and legs, heavy from travel fatigue, felt wonderfully light, and by the end, not only my body but also my mind felt refreshed.

It was the perfect luxurious and relaxing way to end my Bangkok trip. It's a wonderful spa that I would definitely like to return to when I visit Bangkok again.

reviews.name: Rejuvi_Ms. Heo
reviews.text:
+페이셜 관리와 주문한 MARGY'S 제품 수령을 위해 재방문 하였습니다. 다시 만난 Mint는 더욱 더 친절하게 환대를 해주었고 페이셜 관리를 맡은 Aor도 매우 친절하게 시작과 끝을 알리고 적당한 압의 마사지를 제공하였으며 케어의 시작과 끝을 인내심있게 기다려 주었습니다.
+VIE 호텔에서 숙박하며 쉬고 싶어서 방문했습니다.
바디/페이셜 위주로 관리되고 있는 스파이고
스파 내에 별도의 스팀룸이나 사우나는 보이지 않았습니다. 원한다면 욕조가 있는 룸에서 별도로 스파 메뉴를 즐길 수 있어보입니다. 스팀룸은 맞은편 짐 쪽에 있는 것을 보았는데 스파 고객이 사용할 수 있는지는 모르겠습니다.

입장하니 리셉션 직원(Mint)과 테라피스트(Yow?) 모두 매우 친절하게 환대 해주어서 기분이 좋았어요. 고급 스파에 방문하더라도 테라피스트까지 함께 환대 받기 쉽지 않은데 감동했습니다.
상담 결과 아로마 오일 마사지를 추천해주셨고 저도 오일 마사지를 좋아해서 선택했습니다.

바디 제품은 바와를 씁니다. 선택할 수 있는 오일은 아몬드, 올리브, 로즈였는데
로즈는 다른 스파에서도 흔한 편이고 아몬드와 올리브는 흔하지 않기에 특별하게 느껴졌습니다. 최종적으로 올리브로 선택했고 향이 은은해서 만족스러웠습니다. 다시 간다면 아몬드도 받아보고 싶네요.

고급 호텔 스파답게 여유롭게 진행되었습니다. 테라피스트가 영어도 가능하고 응대와 터치도 최상급이었습니다.
린넨을 매우 잘 사용하고 린넨의 감촉도 좋았습니다. 180수 이상의 느낌..?
특히 마사지 베드의 탄력과 시트, 베개의 필파워가 완벽했습니다. 거기서 취침해도 하겠다 싶었어요.
강도 조절은 more soft/more deep으로 가능하고 재촉하지 않아서 너무 좋았어요.
비슷한 가격대로 서울에서도 정기적으로 마사지를 받고 있고 서울의 제 담당 테라피스트가 라 프레리(la prairie) 등 고급 스파 경력자인데 큰 차이가 없었습니다.

페이스 제품은 MARGY'S를 쓰고 있습니다.
페닌슐라 스파 방문했을 때 봤던 제품과 동일해서 물어보니 같은 제품이 맞고 해당 브랜드는 방콕 내 호텔 스파 중에 VIE 스파와 페닌슐라 두 곳에서만 진행된다고 합니다.
스위스 브랜드인데 평소에 유럽 및 스위스 브랜드 스킨케어를 주로 사용하므로 관심을 보이니 흔쾌히 테스터를 사용해볼 수 있게 친절히 도와주고 판매용 제품도 손수 오픈해주어서 편하게 제품들을 접할 수 있었습니다. 재방문 하고 싶네요.

I stayed at VIE Hotel for 6 nights, mainly to relax, and decided to visit the spa. The spa focuses primarily on body and facial treatments. There didn’t seem to be a separate steam room or sauna, but it looks like guests staying in rooms with bathtubs can enjoy in-room spa menus if desired.

Upon arrival, both the receptionist (Mint) and my therapist (Yow?) gave me such a warm welcome—it’s rare to feel so genuinely cared for by both, which was impressive and memorable. After a brief consultation, the consultant recommended an aroma oil massage, which I gladly chose since it’s one of my favorites. They use Bawa body products, and guests can choose from almond, olive, or rose oils. As rose is quite common at other spas, I’d suggest almond or olive for something different. I picked olive, which had a gentle and elegant scent I truly enjoyed. Next time, I’d love to try almond.

As expected from a luxury hotel spa, the entire experience felt unhurried and refined. The therapist communicated well in English, and her technique and demeanor were exceptional. The linens felt soft and high-quality, and the massage bed and pillow were so comfortable that I could’ve easily fallen asleep there. The pressure was well-adjusted at my request (from “more soft” to “more deep”), and there was never any rush. I regularly get massages in Seoul at a similar price range—my therapist there has experience at La Prairie Spa—and the quality here was just as impressive.

For facial treatments, they use MARGY’S products—the same luxury Swiss brand used at The Peninsula Spa. When I mentioned my interest in European skincare, Mint kindly let me try some testers. The products had the refined, subtle fragrance characteristic of luxury skincare. There’s a promotion currently available, and I’m considering taking advantage of it.

Aor, who handled the facial treatment, was also very friendly, signaling the start and end of the session, providing a massage with just the right amount of pressure, and patiently waiting for the care to finish.

They used linens very well, and the texture of the fabric was excellent. It felt like it was over 180 thread count.

In particular, the elasticity of the massage bed, the sheets, and the fill power of the pillows were perfect. I felt like I could even sleep there.

The intensity could be adjusted to "more soft" or "more deep," and I loved that they didn't rush me.

2506 후기남김 누가언니들 변했다했냐 여기 로컬이어도 언니들 압좋고 어깨 킁 다리킁 능추어몽 추천함 반반 1시간임! 내집같은편안함~~~압이걱정되면 수수친구라하세용 알아서해주실것!!!또올겡 언니들알러뷰나카💗🥹💗

솔직히 로컬치고 마사지 잘하는편 압도 좋음 태국어를 조금이라도 할줄안다면 언니들이랑 대화나눠보는거 추천ㅋㅋㅋㅋ진짜웃기심ㅋㅋㅋㅋ돈 많이벌어서 보수공사좀하셨으면~아 그리고 통로치고 마사지쌈 풋 잘하는편! 또가야지~~아 언니들끼리 싸우는거 아님 서로 장난치는거ㅎㅎㅎ진짜웃기고 재밌는곳ㅎㅎ
reviews.textTranslated:
260818 Wow, I've been coming here for 4 years now! If anything has changed since then, it's that the sofa beds and interior have all been renovated and the ladies have all changed. But if there's one thing that remains consistent, it's their skills. How do they manage to perfectly target only the sore spots on my body? I'm so happy. I'll be back. Please stay the same and don't change. ㅠㅠ

+ I've been coming here regularly for 2 years now and still am.

2506 Leaving a review. Who said the ladies have changed? Even though it's a local place, the pressure is great. I recommend the shoulder and leg massages. It's a 1-hour session, half and half! It feels as comfortable as my own home~~~ If you're worried about the pressure, just ask for "Susu Friend." They'll take care of it for you!!! I'll be back. Ladies, I love you ka💗🥹💗

Honestly, for a local place, the massage is pretty good. The pressure is good too. If you know even a little bit of Thai, I recommend chatting with the ladies lol. They're really funny lol. I hope they make a lot of money so they can do some renovations~ Oh, and the massage is cheap for Thonglor. They're pretty good at foot massages! I have to go again~~ Oh, and they weren't fighting, they were just messing around with each other hehe. It's such a funny and fun place hehe.

reviews.text: Very very good massage! One of the best I have had! I asked for the full body oil massage and it was very well done! The lady who did my massage was very nice although she did not speak english. I asked her not to touch my fresh tattoo that I had and she was always very careful around it so I didn’t have any problems! If you’re in bangkok stop by them they have better prices than the stores next to it!

reviews.name: Thilini
reviews.text:
This was the best massage I had in my entire Phuket+krabi Thailand trip. Not only me, my husband also had a lovely experience.

Decided to walk into this place as this was right infront of my hotel ( Gorgeous Boutique Hotel ). By this time, I had done quite a few massages. This place looks very simple. Nothing fancy. You would not think that you would get this much of a good service from the looks of it.

Im very pleased to say that I had a wonderful thai foot massage here. Absolutely amazing. The ladies there were very polite, professional, friendly. They know what they are doing. No funny business. They do what they have to do exceptionally well, I must say.

We got a foot massage for one hour for only 300 baht. This included a lower limb massage upto mid thighs ( so very comprehensive I would say ). And also at the end they do a mini head, neck, shoulder and back massage in Thai style.

Me and my husband both were very pleased and  walked out of there very happily.

Totally recommend this place to you all visiting Patong, Phuket.

reviews.text:
Excellent mini face massage at In Balance Spa
I recently had a mini face massage at In Balance Spa, located in the Novotel hotel in Patong, and it was a great experience. My therapist, May, had excellent technique — skilled, gentle, and professional throughout.
The spa is clean and well-maintained, with a quiet, relaxing room that made it easy to unwind. They use natural products that smell lovely, which added to the overall pleasant atmosphere.
I would definitely recommend In Balance Spa for a relaxing facial treatment. May is particularly good — highly recommended!

reviews.name: J H
reviews.text: Baan Sabai Massage - The only reason I went there was because we stayed close in the hotel next to it. Two different people I had massage with - both massages were not done hard enough, not finding the technique, knots, seems like they do not know where exactly to press harder etc. I have had so many Thai massages in my life, this place is not as great as others, unfortunately. In addition to this, they just gave me a male person without even asking if I agree! Not enough skilled or maybe a bit lazy staff members. Overall, the place is clean. But I do not recommend if you are after a real Thai massage. Paid for nothing, especially second time, felt like the guy was a student, not a professional. Also, the receptionist is not friendly welcoming in my case - she  jumped up to get my my husband in when he walked in just to ask the price for me, but when I came - not so enthusiastic to welcome me, even rolling her eyes as if being annoyed by another female coming. Awful
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are deeply sorry to hear that your experience at Baan Sabai Massage was disappointing. Please accept our sincere apologies for the issues with the massage quality, the therapist assignment, and the service at our front desk. This is certainly not the level of service we aim to provide, and we truly appreciate your input as it helps us improve.

I guess that's why the service has gotten worse.

Most recently, I booked a massage via LINE for 2 PM. The shop said 2:30 PM, and I said okay. They didn't reply after that.

아 여기는 선결제에용!
reviews.textTranslated:
There were no prices displayed outside, but when I went inside, I saw a sign saying a one-hour foot massage was 400 baht. I was about to leave, but they gave me a discount and reduced the price to 300 baht.

When I visited about two years ago, it was just so-so, but I was too lazy to walk far, so I just went in.

I think two years ago, they didn't have resident masseurs and called them in (I'm not entirely sure though). This time, however, I received massages from one resident female masseur and one resident male masseur.

The male masseur massaged my husband, and the female masseur massaged me. Unlike before, we were extremely satisfied!

Both my husband and I were satisfied, so we intend to visit again!

Oh, and you have to pay in advance here!

reviews.name: 黃柏瑋
reviews.text:
這次來 Let's Relax Spa - EmQuartier 體驗四手按摩，整體服務不錯，工作人員態度親切，環境也維持得很舒服。

第一次嘗試四手按摩，兩位按摩師同時進行的感覺滿新奇，和一般按摩的體驗很不一樣，算是這次曼谷旅行中滿有趣的一次嘗試。店的位置方便，生意也不錯，建議事先預約，比較不用擔心臨時沒有適合的時段。
比較可惜的一點是，按摩時沒有可以上鎖存放包包或貴重物品的地方。對國際旅客來說，身上通常會帶護照、現金、信用卡等重要物品，即使整體服務讓人感覺很專業，心理上還是會有一點顧慮。我自己按摩過程中因此不太敢完全睡著放鬆。
如果能提供房內保險箱或可上鎖的置物櫃，整體體驗會更安心、更完整。除此之外，服務和按摩體驗都不錯，想在 EmQuartier 逛街之餘安排按摩，仍然是方便的選擇。
reviews.textTranslated:
I recently tried a four-hand massage at Let's Relax Spa - EmQuartier. The service was excellent overall; the staff were friendly, and the environment was very comfortable.

It was my first time trying a four-hand massage, and the experience of two masseuses working on me simultaneously was quite novel and different from a regular massage. It was one of the more interesting experiences I had during my trip to Bangkok. The location is convenient, and the place was quite popular, so I recommend making a reservation in advance to avoid running out of time slots.

One minor drawback was the lack of a lockable storage area for bags or valuables during the massage. International travelers often carry passports, cash, credit cards, and other important items, so even with the professional service, there was still some apprehension. I was hesitant to fully relax and fall asleep during my massage.

Providing an in-room safe or lockable locker would have made the experience more reassuring and complete. Aside from that, the service and massage experience were excellent, and it would still be a convenient option if you want to combine a massage with shopping at EmQuartier.

reviews.textTranslated:
I stayed at the Marriott, and I visited about three massage shops in the area, but this one was my favorite.

I went to the place right next door twice because it was the closest to my accommodation (it had high ratings), but it was a waste of money... They advertised it as a "sleep massage," but they did it in a really bright place, and even though the masseur was male, I felt like I was stronger than him, which annoyed me.

So I just went to El Club, the place next door, without any expectations.

The owner seemed to be somewhat focused on business, but perhaps because they took pride in their work?

I received a massage from a female masseuse, and it was really good.

First of all, the massage space was dark, the temperature was just right, and the pressure was good. They put a lot of care into it.

If you are staying at the Marriott and looking for a place to go nearby, I think this is the best option. I'm writing this because I don't understand why the rating is only 4.3.

그녀의 권유로 1.5시간 타이마사지+발맛사지+등 & 숄더 딥티슈 콤보를 받았는데 모든 마사지 타입에 1.5시간 캐캐 강하고 균일한 압을 느낄 수 있었고 양쪽 균일한 시퀀스..태국왕실마사지학교 출신은 아니겠지만 연륜이 느껴졌어요.
출국전 마지막도 함께 하려구요.
reviews.textTranslated:
On my sixth day in Chiang Mai, I got massages at different places every day. If I had received a massage from a masseuse named Ta here on the first day, I think I would have continued getting massages here.

At her recommendation, I received the 1.5-hour Thai massage + foot massage + back & shoulder deep tissue combo. For the full 1.5 hours, I could feel strong and even pressure across all massage types, with consistent sequences on both sides. She may not be a graduate of the Royal Thai Massage School, but I could feel her years of experience.

I plan to have my last massage here before my departure as well.

reviews.text: 태국에 여행을 오면 하루에 한번은 마사지를 받는데 작년 여행에 매일 마사지를 받던 분이 이번에 가니 그만두셨다고 해서 새로운 곳을 찾다가 3일째에 ‘다’라는 여자마사지사분께 마사지를 받게 되었습니다. 꼬집히거나 팔꿈치로 찍히는 느낌이 아닌 넓게 강한 압으로 꾹꾹 정성껏해주셔서 너무 시원하고 좋았습니다. 여행이 끝나고 돌아가는 날에는 목, 팔, 허리 관절 곳곳의 가동범위가 여행전보다 훨씬 좋아진게 느껴졌습니다. 마지막 날 ‘다’에게 올가을에 다시 여행 오겠다고 했는데 왔을 때 ‘다’가 여기 꼭 있었으면 좋겠어요.
reviews.textTranslated: Whenever I travel to Thailand, I make it a point to get a massage at least once a day. Last year, the masseuse I used to get massages from every day had quit, so when I arrived this time, I was looking for a new place and ended up getting a massage from a female masseuse named 'Da' on the third day. She applied strong, broad pressure with great care, rather than pinching or being pounded with elbows, which was incredibly refreshing and wonderful. By the time I returned home, I could feel that the range of motion in my neck, arms, and lower back joints had improved significantly compared to before the trip. On the last day, I told 'Da' that I would travel again this autumn, and I really hope she will be here when I come back.

reviews.text:

They truly listen to what you need, adjust the pressure perfectly, and make you feel comfortable from start to finish. Professional, hardworking and very attentive.

I came back four times in my last five days… that says it all 🫰

It’s also right next to the famous roti spot where there’s usually a wait, so honestly… what better way to wait than enjoying a massage?

Thank you again, especially O (yes, his name really is “O” 😊) and Jack, for taking such good care of me. See you soon ✨

reviews.textTranslated:
Haha, on the first day we arrived, my friend and I got full-body massages around 11:10, and it was so incredibly refreshing. Even though it was probably the last time slot, they didn't cut corners at all; they even provided tea and dessert afterward. It was the best!! The masseuses were practically acrobatic, lol. The stretching was done properly, and since we asked them to focus on our shoulders and calves, they really loosened up those areas, making it so refreshing. The only downside was that the masseuse who massaged my friend was a man, and perhaps because he hadn't been doing it for long, his upper body massage was a bit lacking. Still, overall, I was satisfied, and the staff were very hardworking and friendly.

I'm planning to go get a foot massage today~~

reviews.name: Chonnatthakrit D
reviews.text:
I’ve visited this massage shop over ten times, but this latest experience was completely disappointing—from the masseuse to the front desk staff.

During my most recent visit, the masseuse started coughing as if he had a cold; he claimed it was just an allergy to the air conditioning. When I asked if he had a mask to wear, she became visibly annoyed, got up, and left to have another masseuse take over.

The replacement masseuse was thin and kept aggressively working the same knots over and over. I asked her three times to do lighter, but he ignored me completely and kept applying the same heavy pressure. Eventually, I had to tell him to stop the massage entirely. When I reported the issue at the front desk, the male staff member acted annoyed and called a female colleague over to listen. Despite explaining the whole situation, I didn't receive an apology from anyone; they charged the full fee as usual and didn't even offer a word of thanks.

This place is suitable for customers who don't prioritize cleanliness or safety, and who prefer rough massage techniques over proper methods—where bruising your muscles doesn't seem to matter.

ตกใจและผิดหวังกับประสบการณ์ครั้งนี้มากครับ

ระหว่างที่กำลังนวด ผมลุกไปเข้าห้องน้ำหนึ่งครั้ง และเพราะผมไว้ใจพนักงานของร้าน จึงหยิบไปแค่โทรศัพท์ ส่วนกระเป๋ายังวางไว้ในห้อง กระเป๋าของผมเป็นแบบเปิด และกระเป๋าสตางค์อยู่ด้านในค่อนข้างเห็นได้ชัด

หลังจากกลับถึงบ้าน ผมตรวจดูเงินในกระเป๋าสตางค์และพบว่าเงินหายไป 1,000 บาท สิ่งที่ทำให้ผมรู้สึกกังวลมากขึ้นคือ ระหว่างนวดมีช่วงหนึ่งที่พนักงานใช้มือเพียงข้างเดียวอยู่นาน แทนที่จะใช้สองมือ ซึ่งตอนนั้นผมก็รู้สึกแปลกและเริ่มไม่สบายใจแล้ว

ผมไม่สามารถยืนยันได้ว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นแน่นอน และไม่ได้เห็นกับตาว่าใครเป็นคนเอาเงินไป แต่จากช่วงเวลาและสถานการณ์ทั้งหมด ทำให้ผมรู้สึกสงสัยและไม่สบายใจมาก เพราะก่อนเข้าร้านเงินของผมยังอยู่ครบ

สิ่งที่ทำให้ผมผิดหวังยิ่งกว่าคือ ผมทิ้งกระเป๋าไว้ตรงนั้นเพราะเชื่อใจพนักงานของร้าน แต่สุดท้ายกลับบ้านมาแล้วพบว่าเงินหายไป 1,000 บาท เป็นเรื่องที่รับได้ยากมาก

นอกจากเรื่องนี้แล้ว คุณภาพการนวดครั้งนี้ก็แย่มาก แรงนวดเบามาก แทบไม่รู้สึกเหมือนได้รับการนวดจริง ๆ ทั้งที่ผมเคยมาร้านนี้หลายครั้งแล้ว

ร้านนี้ราคาถูกก็จริง แต่จากประสบการณ์ของผม คุณภาพของพนักงานช่วงหลังไม่สม่ำเสมอมาก ประมาณ 10 ครั้ง อาจมีเพียง 2 ครั้งที่รู้สึกว่านวดดี เมื่อหลายปีก่อนพนักงานที่นี่มีฝีมือดีกว่านี้มาก แต่ตอนนี้รู้สึกว่าร้านรับพนักงานที่ยังไม่มีประสบการณ์หรือทักษะการนวดไม่ดีเข้ามาด้วย

หลังจากเหตุการณ์ครั้งนี้ ผมคงไม่กลับมาใช้บริการอีก

อยากเตือนลูกค้าคนอื่น ๆ ให้เก็บกระเป๋าสตางค์ เงินสด และของมีค่าไว้กับตัวตลอดเวลา แม้ว่าจะออกจากห้องเพียงไม่กี่นาทีก็ตาม

I was honestly shocked and extremely disappointed by this experience.

During the massage, I went to the restroom once. Because I trusted the staff, I only took my phone with me and left my bag in the room. My bag is open-style, and my wallet was clearly visible inside.

After I got home and checked my wallet, I realized that 1,000 baht was missing. What made me even more concerned was that during the massage, there was a period when the therapist kept using only one hand instead of both hands. I already felt something was strange at the time.

I cannot say for certain what happened, and I did not personally see anyone take the money. However, considering the timing and the circumstances, the situation feels extremely suspicious and upsetting to me. My money was still there before I went to the shop.

What makes this even more disappointing is that I left my bag there specifically because I trusted the staff. I never expected to come home and discover that 1,000 baht was missing from my wallet.

Aside from this incident, the massage itself was also very poor. The pressure was extremely light and barely felt like a proper massage.

I have visited this shop many times before. The prices are cheap, but in my experience the quality of the therapists has become very inconsistent. Out of around 10 visits, perhaps only 2 were actually good. A few years ago, the therapists here were much more skilled. Now it feels like even inexperienced or poorly trained therapists are being hired.

After this experience, I will not be returning.

I strongly recommend that other customers keep their wallet, cash, and valuables with them at all times, even if they only leave the room for a few minutes.

reviews.name: Bandit 6
reviews.text:
I saw some negative reviews regarding the customer service.  I can say that my experience with whoever was managing the telegram chat was also not very good.

I'm a foreigner with many questions, and at first they answered.  Then I asked for a therapist recommendation based on what I was looking for, saying I was ready to book as soon as they made a recommendation and...they never responded.

I can't review the massage, because I never got one, but if I said something wrong I wish they'd just gently tell me instead of ignoring me.  But, no one was rude to me, so I'll give 2 stars instead of 1.

The massage and therapists at Tata Massage may have been 5 stars but I'll never know, which is unfortunate because the other service I ended up going with...the massage was just okay.  Not bad, but okay.

I had heard Tata had professionally trained therapists, so I guess I missed out and I'm still not sure why they ghosted me because I was ready to pay.

I honestly don't know what or even if I did anything wrong, like asking too many questions, asking silly questions, problems with misunderstandings due to the language barrier etc. etc.

For the record, I'm NOT reviewing for a competing service, and maybe there's a good explanation for why they stopped responding just when I was ready to book...but I don't know what that could be.

If I had a recommendation for Tata massage (not that they asked), it would be to be a little more patient with silly questions from foreigners who don't know any better and just gently correct them if they make a mistake. 🙏

reviews.text:
별하나도 아까운 집입니다.
타이마사지 1시간 30분짜리 하기로 하고 들어갔습니다.  너무 마사지를 못해서 1시간으로 해달라고 요청했습니다.
나는 친구만나러 간다고 한적이 없습니다.

그런데 1시간도 아닌것 같아서 30분받은것만 150밧주고 가겠다고 하고 계산할때 500밧을 냈습니다.

돈을 받고 나와서 밖에서 계산해보니 250밧입니다.  350밧이어야 할돈이.
그래서 주인과 cctv를 돌려 받지만 주인은 100밧짜리 세지도 않고 20밧짜리 2장하고 5밧짜리동전을 2개 내주었습니다.

이건 신뢰의 문제입니다.
최악의 마사지에 돈 계산도 참 나는 할말을 잃었습니다.

나도 그자리에서 보지 않은게 문제겠지만 참 살다살다 내가 100밧에 목숨걸일도 아니고 그냥 나와버렸습니다.

문밖으로 나올때쯤 따라 나오면서 100밧을
주는데 안받고.   잘먹고 잘살라고 했습니다.

참 오늘 일진이 별로 안좋네요.

추가

나만 이런 마사지를 받았나 리뷰를 찾아보니
10개월전 어떤사람도 별하나와 리뷰를 쓴것이 있습니다.  "최악의 마사지와 주인의 응대문제라고 말했습니다"

나는 이리뷰를 읽고 공감했습니다.
아 이런리뷰가 있다는것은 주인의 응대 문제가 있는 집입니다.  한번 참고하세요.
reviews.textTranslated:
This place doesn't even deserve one star.

I went in agreeing to a 1.5-hour Thai massage. The massage was so poor that I asked them to extend it to an hour.

I never mentioned that I was going to meet a friend.

However, since it didn't seem like an hour, I said I would just pay 150 baht for the 30 minutes and leave, but I paid 500 baht when I paid.

After receiving the money and leaving, I calculated the bill outside and it was 250 baht. It should have been 350 baht.

So I asked the owner to return the CCTV footage, but the owner didn't even count the 100-baht bills and just handed me two 20-baht bills and two 5-baht coins.

This is a matter of trust.

With the worst massage ever, I was truly speechless regarding the bill calculation.

It might be my fault for not seeing it right then and there, but honestly, I've lived long enough not to risk my life for 100 baht, so I just walked out.

As I was leaving, they followed me out the door and offered me 100 baht, but I refused to take it. I told them to eat well and live well.

Well, today is really not my day.

Addition

I looked up reviews to see if I was the only one who received a massage like this, and found that someone else wrote a one-star review 10 months ago. "They said it was the worst massage and the owner's attitude was problematic."

I read this review and agreed with it.

Ah, the fact that there is a review like this means there is an issue with the owner's attitude. Please keep that in mind.

reviews.name: Honest Reviews Only
reviews.text:
I was staying at the Avani hotel and noticed this massage place in the basement of the connecting mall. The prices looked reasonable, so I decided to try their 90 min foot, shoulder, and neck massage.

I waited about 10 mins for the therapist to arrive, which wasn't too bad. However, my seat was positioned directly next to the shop window. This was a bit uncomfortable as I was the first thing people saw when walking past the shop, offering very little in terms of privacy.
The massage itself was excellent. I requested a stronger massage, and the therapist delivered with exactly the right amount of pressure. If you are looking for a high-quality, strong massage, the skill level here is definitely there.

On the downside, the environment could be improved. The shop is quite cramped and doesn't feel particularly well-maintained in terms of hygiene. I didn't see the seats being cleaned or sanitized after customers who had been sitting or lying there for an hour or more.

Overall, it was a great massage at a very reasonable price point. If you don't mind the lack of privacy and a more basic environment, it’s a solid spot for a quick recharge.

reviews.name: Donna ClassyCompass
reviews.text:
🍀 That night around 11 p.m., our group booked a tuk-tuk to go for a massage. The driver asked if we wanted a recommendation and said the place was reputable, with certified and professionally trained staff. We trusted him and agreed.
When we arrived, there were packages of 60, 90, and 120 minutes. We chose the 120-minute package for 1,200 baht. A friend checked the reviews, found them poor, and suggested going to Nikko Massage next door. When the staff noticed us discussing it, they immediately offered a discount to 1,000 baht. Since we were already there and it was late, we decided to stay.
The experience did not meet expectations:
•  The 120-minute session was actually shortened by about 30 minutes.
•  The massage technique was very basic — mostly light rubbing rather than a proper massage.
•  Right after it ended, before we could even sit up, they asked for a tip twice.
I have had massages at many places in Thailand, but this was the worst. I would not recommend this place. If you are considering it, please check other reviews or choose a more reputable shop.
This is only my personal experience; others may feel differently.🙏
🍀 那天晚上大约 11 点，我们一行人叫了嘟嘟车去按摩。司机问要不要介绍地方，说那家店信誉好，员工都有证书、受过专业培训。我们相信了他，就同意了。
到店后有 60 分钟、90 分钟、120 分钟几种套餐。我们选了 120 分钟，价格 1,200 泰铢。朋友看了评价觉得不好，想改去旁边的 Nikko Massage。店员看到我们在商量，立刻把价格降到 1,000 泰铢。因为已经到了，而且比较晚，我们就决定留下来。
体验并不理想：
•  选的是 120 分钟，实际少做了大约 30 分钟。
•  手法很敷衍，基本只是在身上轻轻揉一揉，不像正规按摩。
•  刚结束，人还没坐起来，就被连着提醒了两次要小费。
我在泰国做过不少按摩，这是最差的一次。不建议来这家。如果还在考虑，建议先看看其他评价，或选择更靠谱的店。
以上只是我的个人体验，每个人感受可能不同。🙏
🍀 Tối hôm đó khoảng 11 giờ, nhóm mình gọi tuktuk đi mát-xa. Tài xế hỏi có muốn được giới thiệu chỗ không, nói chỗ đó uy tín, nhân viên đều có bằng cấp và được đào tạo chuyên nghiệp. Vì tin lời nên mình đồng ý.
Đến nơi có nhiều gói 60 – 90 – 120 phút. Nhóm mình chọn gói 120 phút giá 1.200 baht. Bạn mình xem review thấy không tốt, muốn chuyển sang Nikko Massage kế bên. Nhân viên thấy vậy liền giảm còn 1.000 baht. Vì đã đến nơi và khá muộn nên nhóm mình quyết định ở lại.
Trải nghiệm không như kỳ vọng:
•  Gói 120 phút nhưng thực tế bị rút ngắn khoảng 30 phút.
•  Kỹ thuật mát-xa rất sơ sài, chủ yếu là xoa nhẹ trên người, không đúng bài bản.
•  Vừa kết thúc, chưa kịp ngồi dậy đã bị nhắc tip hai lần.
Mình từng mát-xa nhiều nơi ở Thái Lan nhưng đây là lần tệ nhất. Không nên trải nghiệm chỗ này. Ai đang cân nhắc thì nên xem thêm review khác hoặc chọn chỗ uy tín hơn.
Đây chỉ là trải nghiệm cá nhân của mình, mỗi người có thể cảm nhận khác nhau🙏

Meine erste Massage war bei Mimi, nach dieser Massage bin ich jeden Tag zur Massage in den Laden gegangen. Ich hatte jedes Mal eine Öl Massage. Ich war schon häufiger in Thailand und hatte überall Massagen. Die Massagen von Mimi waren bisher die besten in meinem Leben. Sobald ich in Bangkok bin werde ich Charissa Thai Massage wieder aufsuchen und auf alle Fälle wieder Mimi verlangen.
reviews.textTranslated: I chose Charissa Thai Massage because they have private rooms. I want to relax during a massage and not be interrupted by people walking around or other disturbances. My first massage was with Mimi, and after that, I went to the shop every day. I always had an oil massage. I always chose Mimi; the massages were so relaxing and gentle that I always felt very loose and relaxed afterward. I've been to Thailand many times and had massages everywhere. Mimi's massages were by far the best I've ever had. As soon as I'm in Bangkok, I'll go back to Charissa Thai Massage and definitely ask for Mimi again.
