reviews.text:
여기서 발마사지를 받고 두드러기가 발생하여 직원에게 항의하였지만 직원은 원래 마사지전부터 있던 두드러기라고 하였습니다. 상식적으로 저정도 두드러기가 있는데 제가 마사지를 하러 온다는게 말이 안되고 마사지사도 이정도 두드러기가 있다면 안하는게 정상아닌가요?
그럼에도 혹시나 병이 생겼을까 싶어 병원을 다녀왔으나 일반 두드러기라고 합니다. 사장님이 한국사람이래서 연락을 요청하였지만 직원은 사장님과 연결시켜주지않았고 나중에 사장님이 연락할 것이니 연락처만 두고 가라해서 두고 갔으나 끝내 연락이 오지않았습니다. 사장님 병원비라도 좀 주세요 ㅠ
마사지 가격 환불도 안바랍니다. 직원이 원래부터 있던 거라고 거짓말만 안했어도 병원 갈 생각도 없었어요 ㅠ
reviews.textTranslated:
I developed hives after receiving a foot massage here, so I complained to the staff, but they claimed the hives were present before the massage. Logically speaking, it makes no sense for me to come for a massage with hives this severe, and shouldn't the masseuse have refused to perform the service if they have hives like that?

Consequently, worried that I might have developed an illness, I visited a hospital, but they said it was just general hives. I asked to speak with the owner, as I heard they are Korean, but the staff refused to connect me. They told me to just leave my contact information, saying the owner would reach out later, so I did, but I never received a call. Owner, please at least help with the hospital bills.

I am not even asking for a refund for the massage. If the staff hadn't lied and claimed the hives were pre-existing, I wouldn't have even considered going to the hospital.

reviews.text: 店名は、ルンアルン RUNG  AROON　1時間120バーツ＝600円は、18時以降は150バーツ＝750円に。市内の相場は、1時間350バーツ～650バーツ＝1750円～3250円　超格安です。このGoogle表示での店の1階です。2階は別のお店です。何も言わずとも嫁には女性、私には男性のスタッフが担当となりました。N-Mark Plazaのマッサージ1時間での工程が10とすれば、ここの2時間の工程は100程の様々なマッサージ方法で感激しました。男性は2時間、全く力を緩める事がありませんでした。超お薦めです。チャォラプヤー川沿いで川風が吹いて、ゆっくりとした時間がながれる、優しい所です。
reviews.textTranslated: The name of the shop is RUNG AROON, and the hourly rate is 120 baht (600 yen), dropping to 150 baht (750 yen) after 6pm. The going rate in the city is 350-650 baht (1,750-3,250 yen) per hour, so it's super cheap. This is the first floor of the shop shown on Google. The second floor is a different shop. Without any further ado, my wife was attended to by a female staff member, and I by a male staff member. If the one-hour massage at N-Mark Plaza has 10 steps, the two-hour massage here had around 100 different massage methods, which I was impressed with. The man didn't let up at all for two hours. Highly recommended. It's a gentle place along the Chao Lapya River, with the river breeze blowing and time passing slowly.

reviews.textTranslated: The overall massage experience at Thai Comfort Wellness Center was excellent. The environment was comfortable and clean, and the atmosphere was instantly relaxing. The masseuses were skilled, with excellent pressure control, and adjusted their techniques according to individual needs, paying close attention to areas prone to soreness such as the shoulders, neck, and lower back. The entire process was comfortable and relaxing, and I felt noticeably lighter afterward. The staff were friendly, and the prices were reasonable, making it a highly recommended choice for relaxation during travel or anytime you want to unwind.

reviews.name: DEAN
reviews.text: 真的是我這輩子體驗過最舒服的一次按摩。師傅們彷彿對人體構造瞭若指掌，總能精準地在穴位周圍找到最需要放鬆的位置，尤其對骨頭的深層按壓特別講究。泰式按摩獨有的伸展與踩踏手法更是一絕，師傅運用全身重量穩定地踩壓在身體各處，力道深沉卻恰到不好處。每一次按壓都像是在打開緊繃已久的筋膜，讓身體逐漸舒展開來。按摩結束後，不只是肌肉放鬆，也是精神上的折磨，真正感受到身心靈合而為一的療癒感。
reviews.textTranslated: This was truly the most comfortable massage I've ever experienced. The masseuses seemed to have an unparalleled understanding of human anatomy, always able to pinpoint the most vulnerable spots around acupoints, with particular attention to deep pressure on the bones. The unique stretching and foot-pressing techniques of Thai massage were exceptional; the masseuse used their full weight to steadily press on various parts of the body, applying deep yet perfectly balanced pressure. Each press felt like opening up long-tightened fascia, allowing the body to gradually relax. After the massage, it wasn't just muscle relaxation, but also a mental and emotional release, a truly healing experience that brought body, mind, and spirit together.

reviews.text:
이건 내가 나중에 볼라고 쓰는 후기.
쌩돈 내면서 깨달은 몇가지를 알려줌.
1. 후기에 태국인만 있다. 그러면 의심해야함. 로컬 명문일수도 있지만 지인들의 영업일수도 있음
2. 4박5일짜리 단기 여행으로 오는 한국인들 후기좀 경계하자. 비유하자면 한국 명동 길에서 떡볶이 한접시 만원에 먹고 최고라고 후기적는 미국사람 생각남. 맛이 없다는게 아니라 한국인은 만원주고 떡볶이 안먹다. 관광객용 가게.
3. 뭔가 슬로우비디오처럼 느리게 마사지 하면서 손으로는 살짝 피부만 간지럽힌다. 이러면 쎄게해달라 요구할 필요도 없음. 그냥 망한거니까 시간을 버릴지 돈을 버릴지 생각하고 일어나야함.

여기를 찾느라 다른데 다니며 돈버린 생각하니 시간과 노력이 너무 아깝..

동남아에서 받은 100개 이상 마사지중 시원함이 최고인지는 모르나 가격대비로 하면 최고다.
reviews.textTranslated:
This is a review I'm writing for myself to look back on later.

Here are a few things I learned while paying my own money.

1. If the reviews are only from Thai people, you should be suspicious. It could be a prestigious local establishment, but it could also be a business promotion by their acquaintances.

2. Be wary of reviews from Koreans on short 4-night, 5-day trips. To use an analogy, it reminds me of an American who eats a plate of tteokbokki for 10,000 won on Myeongdong Street in Korea and writes a review saying it's the best. It's not that it tastes bad, but Koreans wouldn't pay 10,000 won for tteokbokki. It's a shop catering to tourists.

3. The massage is done in slow motion, and their hands only lightly tickle your skin. If this happens, there is no need to ask them to massage harder. It's just a failure, so you have to decide whether to waste your time or your money before leaving.

Thinking about the time and effort I wasted going to other places just to find this place makes me feel so regretful...

I don't know if it's the most refreshing of the over 100 massages I've received in Southeast Asia, but considering the price, it is the best.

We are a small Thai massage school of highly trained and highly accomplished massage therapists. All of our teachers have real experience in the professional world of massage therapy, several at the highest level of spa service. After extensive careers abroad, our lead teachers returned to their native Thailand and, while still maintaining their healing work on clients, started to devote their passion for massage into teaching others. SVG Thai massage school Chiangmai as a private Thai massage study class.

reviews.name: Samantha Oetting
reviews.text: SVG is my home-base for my thai massage education. Master PP and Master Aire have been teaching for decades, and pass along family lineage. This is the best thai massage program in Chiang Mai. Smaller classes and more attention to detail.

reviews.name: zaldy miranda
reviews.text: Without bias, but just with the level of skills, competencies, and professionalism of the instructors, I would highly recommend SVG.  I have just completed two courses under the wings of Master Aire: deep tissue Thai massage (for 5 days) and feet reflexology for 2 days (Sat and Sun).  Master Aire is a top-notch.  She's well-spoken, understandable, keen to details, and her level of expertise is 10/10, her teaching method is strict but loving.  Her techniques and way of explaining what seems to be complicated made it easier for me to understand, absorb and apply everything she taught me.  I got lucky to have been the only student in those classes at that time, so I had a private one-on-one with the master.  Right after the class, I was already able to apply everything I learned to my friends.  I made sure to note down everything, even the littlest and slightest techniques, cos they're all essential knowledge for me.  Master PP reignited my interest in meditation.  Without fail, everyday during the course, our day will start with prayers and meditation.  He would even add on healing for me and the other students.  His prayers and intentions for his students is genuine and apparent.  They are both welcoming, warm and always with best interests for their students.  The class, all throughout, felt more like a personalised experience, a knowledge transfer than a money-making school.  It is, without a doubt, that these things be considered when choosing a school.  I'm sure to come back for my Thai Massage classes!

reviews.textTranslated: This is my favorite and most beloved school. Both the meditation and massage are wonderful. I plan to visit again this year. I miss you, PPmaster🙏

reviews.name: roni2908
reviews.text:
Today I completed five days of a basic Thai massage course (Level 1) at SVG School in Chiang Mai, and I wholeheartedly recommend it!

The school is an absolute gem. Classes are small and intimate—we were just two students in the group, and there’s also an option for one-on-one lessons. This is a huge advantage compared to other schools with large classes. Despite the same price, the personalized attention here makes the learning experience far superior. For me, the cost was incredibly reasonable considering the quality.

The instructor was amazing—not only highly skilled but also a true teacher for life. He shared deep knowledge, taught meditation techniques, and spoke about the philosophy of life behind Thai massage. This experience was much more than technical training; it was something meaningful I’ll carry with me.

If you're considering learning Thai massage in Chiang Mai, I highly recommend SVG!

ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิว ร้านนี้มีลูกค้ามาใช้บริการเป็นจำนวนมากในแต่ละวัน เพราะราคาเป็นกันเอง และเป็นห้องรวม ไม่มีห้อง วีไอพี แต่มีผ้าม่านกั้นทุกห้องทุกเตียง พนักงานต้อนรับก็ต้องมีการพูดจากับลูกค้า เพื่อที่จะจัดหาห้องหาเตียงเป็นเรื่องปกติของทางร้าน ที่มีค่าบริการที่เป็นมิตร เหมือนร้านนวดทั่วๆไป เพราะนี่คือร้านนวด ไม่ไช่ สปา ที่มีห้องส่วนตัว หรือห้อง วีไอพี เพื่อรองรับลูกค้าที่มาเป็นคู่ หรือครอบครัว อีกอย่างสำหรับเรื่อง พนักงานที่เจ้าของใช้คำพูดต่อพนักงานคนนั้น เธอมีพฤติกรรมที่ไม่เหมาะสมต่อเพื่อนร่วมงาน หลายครั้งหลายครา ยกตัวอย่าง ลูกค้าประจำมาขอใช้บริการกับพนักงานคนเก่า แต่เธอไม่ให้พนักงานคนนั้นบริการลูกค้า เพราะพนั
กงานคนนั้นได้ทิปเยอะกว่า และนวดดีกว่า แต่เธอห้ามให้พนักงานคนดังกล่าวรับบริการ อีกเรื่อง ตอนคุณกับแฟนคุณเข้ารับบริการ เธอ(คนที่ยิ้มแย้ม) ได้ล๊อคประตู เพื่อไม่ให้พนักงานคนอื่นพาลูกค้าเข้าไปใช้บริการในห้องรวมห้องนั้นด้วย เพราะนโยบายของร้าน คือต้องใช้ห้องร่วมกัน แต่แยกแต่ละเตียง ซึ่งมีผ้าม่านกั้นไว้ สามีคุณมาใช้บริการเป็นครั้งที่3 ครั้งที่1/2 พอใจ ถูกใจมากซึ่งได้รับบริการจากพนักงานคนอื่น ที่ไม่ไช่เธอ(คนที่ยิ้มแย้ม) ปัญหาไม่มี แต่พอมานวดกับเธอมีปัญหาทันที ทางร้านก็ไม่รู้ว่า ระหว่างนวด เธอได้พูดคุยอะไรกัน เลยกลายเป็นเรื่องดังกล่าวที่เกิดขึ้น ท้ายสุด ทางร้านและเจ้าของร้านเป็นคนยุติธรรมกับพนักงานทุกคน คนไหนดี บริการดี ก็ดีต่อลูกค้าและชื่อเสียงร้าน แต่พนักงานคนไหนไม่ดี ชอบกลั่นแกล้งเพื่อนร่วมงาน เอาดีเข้าตัวเอง โดยไม่คำนึงถึงผลกระทบต่อสถานบริการ เจ้าของก็ต้องจัดการขั้นเด็ดขาด เพราะถ้าไร้ซึ่งความยุติธรรม ไม่ว่าสังคมไหน ก็อยู่ไม่ได้ โปรดวางใจเป็นกลาง ขอบคุณ

reviews.text: This is the worst and dirtiest massage parlor I've ever been to. It's incredibly noisy during the massage, the staff are loud, and the boss is extremely loud. I do not recommend this place and I will never go back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิว ขอบคุณลูกค้าที่มาใช้บริการ3ครั้ง ครั้งที่1/2พนักงานบริการดีต่อคุณ แต่ครั้งสุดท้ายคุณได้รับบริการจากพนักงานที่มีปัญหา คุณและแฟนของคุณ นวดชั่วโมงครึ่ง และได้นวดครบชั่วโมงครึ่ง แต่ระหว่างนวดคุณไม่ได้พูดเรื่องเสียงดัง และได้ให้พนักงานคนดังกล่าวปิดประตูล๊อค เพื่อไม่ให้ลูกค้าท่านอื่นเข้าไปใช้บริการร่วมห้อง ซึ่งมีเตียงร่วม และมีผ้าม่านกั้น ร้านนวดไม่ไช่สปา ที่จะมีห้องสำหรับรองรับลูกค้า วีไอพี หรือครอบครัว นี่คือร้านนวดที่มีห้อง และเตียงนวดที่ใช้ร่วมกัน ลูกค้าของร้านเยอะ ก็ต้องเข้าใจด้วยกับการใช้เสียง เพราะราคา ค่าบริการเป็นกันเอง เหมือนกับร้านนวดทั่วๆไป เริ่มต้น300บาท/ชั่วโมง ถ้าคุณต้องการร้านที่เงียบ และสะอาดที่สุด แนะนำให้ไปสปา แต่ราคาอาจจะเริ่มต้นที่1500-2000 บาท อีกอย่างพอคุณนวดเสร็จ คุณจะไม่จ่ายตามราคา ถ้าจิตที่ดีคุณควรออกมาพูดระหว่างนวด แต่คุณนวดครบชั่วโมงครึ่ง คุณจะจ่ายไม่ครบตามจำนวน อีกอย่างคุณก็มาด่าถึงบุพการีอีก ฉันเปิดร้านนวดมาเกือบ20ปี ไม่เคยมีใครมาด่าบุพการีแบบนี้  อีกอย่างผู้หญิงคนที่นวดคุณคือผู้หญิงไม่ดี ชอบกลั่นแกล้ง ต่อว่าพนักงานคนอื่นอยู่ประจำ ฉันให้โอกาสเธอมาหลายครั้ง แต่เธอก็ยังทำตัวไม่ดีมาตลอด ทำตัวเหมือนเจ้าของร้าน พนักงานคนอื่นไม่อยากเข้าใกล้เลย ฉันให้เขาออกแล้ว ทางร้านมีความยุติธรรม และรักพนักงานทุกคน คนไหนไม่ดีก็ตักเตือน อบรมมาโดยตลอด แต่ถ้าตักเตือนหลายครั้ง แต่ยังมีพฤติกรรมเหมือนเดิม ทางร้านก็ให้ออกจากงาน เพื่อที่จะได้บุคลากรที่ดี มีคุณภาพ ลูกค้าจะได้ประทับใจ โปรดเปิดใจของคุณเถิด  ขอบคุณ

reviews.name: Jenny Le
reviews.text: I have been to Thailand for many times for many years. I have the first bad experience at this massage shop. The lady boss told us to wait for 20 minutes for 2 people massage. I told her that I can wait for 20 minutes but I need to leave at 6pm to catch a flight. She promised just wait for 20 minutes only. My husband and I waited for 30 minutes. She sent my husband in for massage and asked me to wait for another 5 minutes. I ended up waited for another 35 minutes while my husband was in the room. The massage for both of us was below average. 日本の方向けに書きます。おすすめしません。
Iceちゃんという子を指名し90分Null Bath Room 3000Bahtで入りました。
しかし実際にはマットを使うことなく、オイルマッサージと何が違うのかわかりませんでした。
Iceちゃん曰く、小さいので使わないとのこと。確かにBath Roomには想像するマットプレイ用の半分くらいのサイズが立て掛けてありました。
また、60分経ったほどで2発目を発射するとそそくさと準備を始めシャワーを一瞬で浴びて終了となりました。浴びた後も急かされながら準備をさせられ退転させられました。ママさんに文句を言おうとも思いましたが、そんな暇すらなく追い出された気分です。店に"入って"から"出る"まで65分ほどでした。他店なら残った時間はマッサージするなり責めてお話しなりとなるのでは？
マットプレイもなく、60分終了とは話が違いすぎます。返金して欲しいと思ったの初めてです。本当におすすめしません。
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm writing this for Japanese customers. I do not recommend this place.
I requested a girl named Ice and booked a 90-minute session in a Null Bath Room for 3000 Baht.
However, she didn't actually use a mat, and I couldn't tell the difference between this and an oil massage.
Ice said she didn't use one because it was too small. Indeed, there was a mat propped up in the bathroom, about half the size you'd expect for mat play.
Also, after about 60 minutes, she quickly started getting ready after my second round, took a quick shower, and it was over. Even after showering, she rushed me to get ready and made me leave. I wanted to complain to the madam, but I didn't even have time; I felt like I was being kicked out. From "entering" the shop to "leaving," it was about 65 minutes. At other places, wouldn't the remaining time be used for a massage or some kind of teasing/conversation?

With no mat play and the session ending after 60 minutes, it was completely different from what was promised. This is the first time I've ever wanted a refund. I really do not recommend this place.

reviews.name: chamisul
reviews.text:
A convenient, dependable wellness spot tucked away on the lower level of Jungceylon Shopping Center, making it an ideal stop to recharge tired legs and shoulders during a shopping run in Patong.

​Stopped by while exploring Jungceylon and opted for a 60-minute foot and head/neck combo massage. As is generally true across Thailand, the baseline technique and pressure were solidly on point, delivering effective relief from hours of walking. The shop interior is decently maintained, clean, and provides a calm, air-conditioned environment right within the bustling mall.

​One minor operational hiccup was that one colleague’s session started noticeably later than the rest of the group, which required a short wait at the end for everyone to finish up. That aside, its accessible basement location and solid massages make it a very practical refuge to break up a downtown Patong itinerary.

8月下旬の平日にいきました。
自分はタイ旅行が初めてで行く前に々調べて、夜の街も同様にしました。

グーグルマップや情報サイトを見る中で、駅が近くて優良店とあったので、こちらの店が良いかなと思い21時頃に入店。

店先で数名のスタッフさんが出迎えてくれて、店内で日本語の話せるオーナーと思われる方が対応してくれました。

店内は落ち着いた雰囲気でおすすめのスタッフを紹介してくれ、その中から好みの子を選びました。

コースはタイ式オイルマッサージ60分。
室内は清潔感があり、オイルマッサージ・サービスも自分が希望していた内容通りでとても満足できました。

マッサージ後もタイ語・英語が話せない自分に翻訳アプリでコミュニケーションを取ってくれて楽しく会話ができました。
可愛くて優しくて明るいとてもいい子に出会えて嬉しかったです。

初心者の自分でも安心してリラックスしてマッサージを楽しめたので、タイ語・英語を学んで次にタイに来た時もお店に行かせてもらいます。
ありがとうございました！
reviews.textTranslated:
I went on a weekday in late August.

This was my first trip to Thailand, so I did a lot of research beforehand, including looking at the nightlife.

While looking at Google Maps and information sites, I found this place near a station and it was listed as a good establishment, so I thought it would be a good choice and went in around 9 PM.

Several staff members greeted me at the entrance, and inside, a person who seemed to be the owner and could speak Japanese assisted me.

The interior had a calm atmosphere, and they introduced me to recommended staff members, from whom I chose the one I liked best.

I chose the 60-minute Thai oil massage course.

The room was clean, and the oil massage service was exactly what I had hoped for, so I was very satisfied.

Even after the massage, they used a translation app to communicate with me, as I don't speak Thai or English, and we had a pleasant conversation.

I was so happy to meet such a cute, kind, and cheerful girl.

Even as a beginner, I was able to relax and enjoy the massage with peace of mind, so I will learn Thai and English and visit this shop again the next time I come to Thailand.

Thank you!

reviews.textTranslated: I went on a weekday evening and there were four rather strict girls. Nevertheless, the massage itself was good, just as the reviews said. They put a lot of pressure on me. But that was about it. I can't go into details, but everything else was terrible. The price was reasonable, they even gave me a further discount, I got free water, and at the end I even got dessert (a nicely peeled, cold orange), and the room was clean, but they were really cutting corners in many areas. Of course, I probably just got a girl like that by chance, but if the first time is like this, it's hard to imagine going back a second time. If the first time is a hit and the second time is a miss, a third time is possible, but if the first time is a miss, it's hard to bring yourself to go back a second time, especially in this area which is very competitive.

reviews.text:
We were looking for an authentic Thai massage and found this place with good reviews. The place was grand and neat with nice interiors.

reviews.name: Michael Kakareko
reviews.text:
The worst massage experience I’ve ever had. The first woman we encountered had a terrible attitude while checking us in. We should have taken that as a sign and turned around and left.

The front of the building looks nice, but then they take you up three floors to a hot, stuffy, and unpleasant part of the building. They left the door open and told us to undress, then became irritated when we asked to close the door for privacy.

Throughout the massage, the staff were constantly chatting and laughing, while loud music from the bar next door could be heard clearly. The massage itself was extremely half-hearted and was cut short. The whole experience can best be described as uncomfortable and it really felt like they were just going for a happy ending massage. Before I even had a chance to get up, they immediately started asking for tips, despite providing an incredibly poor and uncomfortable experience.

We specifically booked an aloe vera massage, but were given a basic oil massage instead.

To make matters worse, when we went downstairs to leave, our shoes were missing. After we looked around for a minute, the massage therapist walked outside, threw our shoes down, and walked away without saying a word.

Overall, this was an awful experience from start to finish. Save yourself the trouble and go to literally any other massage shop.

reviews.name: Jordan Mendoza
reviews.text: Horrible experience. DO NOT come here. The staff is rude talked to each other the entire time and gave very low effort. It was not relaxing at all. She spent the entire hour on my legs and applied very minimal pressure after I asked for medium. I had my eyes wide open the entire time because I was not at all relaxed and she noticed this and did not care. As soon as she was done she asked for a tip before I even had an opportunity to give one and I was not planning on it due to how bad the experience was. Go to Panan massage around the corner instead. This place sucks and I regret trying it.

reviews.name: Fatih ŞENDÖL
reviews.text:
Masaj mı, eziyet mi? Defalarca uyarıya rağmen omurga bölgesine baskı devam etti.

Daha önce bu işletmede birkaç kez hizmet aldım ve memnun kaldığım için tekrar tercih ettim. Sahildeki şubelerinde de masaj yaptırdım ve oldukça olumlu deneyimler yaşadım. Daha önce çalışanların nazik ve profesyonel yaklaşımından memnundum.

Ancak bu son ziyaretim maalesef büyük bir hayal kırıklığı oldu. Masajı yapan genç hanımefendi daha başlangıçtan itibaren oldukça sert ve özensiz davrandı. Masaj sırasında omurga bölgeme yapılan baskının rahatsız edici olduğunu birkaç kez açıkça söyledim ve baskıyı azaltmasını rica ettim.

Özellikle “Omurgama bastırıyorsunuz, bu benim için problem olabilir” diye uyarmama rağmen aynı şekilde devam edildi. Bir noktada masajı bırakıp çıkmayı düşündüm ancak eşim de aynı anda masaj aldığı için ortamı bozmak istemedim.

Daha önce aldığım hizmetlerle kıyasladığımda bu deneyim kesinlikle aynı seviyede değildi. Masajın amacı rahatlatmak ve iyi hissettirmek olmalı; bu uygulama ise benim için aşırı sert, kontrolsüz ve rahatsız edici bir deneyim oldu.

Umarım işletme bu geri bildirimi dikkate alır ve müşterilerin “acı oluyor, baskıyı azaltın” şeklindeki net uyarılarına daha fazla önem verir.
reviews.textTranslated:
Massage or torture? Despite repeated warnings, pressure continued on my spine.

I have received services from this establishment several times before and was satisfied, so I chose to return. I also had massages at their beach branch and had very positive experiences. I was pleased with the polite and professional approach of the staff.

However, this last visit was unfortunately a great disappointment. The young woman performing the massage was quite rough and careless from the very beginning. I clearly stated several times that the pressure on my spine was uncomfortable and asked her to reduce the pressure.

Especially after warning her, "You are pressing on my spine, this could be a problem for me," she continued in the same manner. At one point, I considered leaving the massage, but since my wife was also receiving a massage at the same time, I didn't want to spoil the atmosphere.

Compared to the services I have received before, this experience was definitely not on the same level. The purpose of a massage should be to relax and make you feel good; this application was an excessively rough, uncontrolled, and uncomfortable experience for me.

Hopefully, the business will take this feedback into account and pay more attention to customers' clear warnings such as "it's painful, reduce the pressure."

• The silver color was too dark, so I tried to say "Gemini" indirectly, but they said it was magnetic gel and the color varies depending on the direction.

Just because I mentioned it twice, they started badmouthing me and their colleague?

They also got the Kitty's eyes and nose positioned wrong, so when I asked them to redo it, they got angry. I wasted my money and time, and they completely ruined my mood on the first day of my trip.

I should have just said it was fine when they wiped off the Kitty face once, even though I should have paid the full 35,000 won.

I wanted an apology and a refund, but we couldn't communicate.

It's my fault for not being able to speak Thai.

reviews.name: Karim Ismail
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 – Avoid This Place. Scammy and Extremely Unprofessional

We booked in advance for 3 people and arrived on time at 6:00 PM. Instead of welcoming us, the staff immediately told us that because we had selected “special” masseurs, we must pay a minimum 1,000 THB tip per person. This was never mentioned during booking. When we refused and said any masseur is fine, their attitude completely changed—cold, rude, and dismissive.

Despite arriving on time, they kept us waiting:
•	First person taken at 6:20
•	Second 5 minutes later
•	My session started around 6:30 because the masseur was late

When my massage finally started, it was a disaster. The masseur was non-stop talking, completely unprofessional, and his phone kept ringing throughout the session. After only 10 minutes, staff came in and told me they had to change my masseur because another client booked him.

At that point, I refused to continue and stopped the massage. Instead of apologizing, they were rude, defensive, and refused to refund any money from the 90-minute session I had fully prepaid, even though the service was clearly not delivered.

This place feels like it’s designed to pressure customers for extra money, then treat them badly if they don’t comply. No professionalism, no respect for reservations, and terrible customer service.

I absolutely do NOT recommend Nap Bangkok Spa.
This was a complete waste of time and money, and it felt like a straight-up scam.

reviews.name: 난1조인
reviews.text:
남자마사지사가 제 가슴과 팬티를 지속적으로 쳐다봤습니다.
커플로 오늘 발마사지 받고왔습니다.
전 여자마사지사가, 남자친구는 ‘콧수염과 턱수염이 난 남자마사지사’가 해줬습니다.
날이 더워서 민소매 원피스를 입고갔는데 다리를 위로 뻗어 마사지 받는 동작을 할때 “남자 마사지사가 계속 팬티를 쳐다보더군요.”
처음엔 인지를 못했어요. 돈 내고 받는 마사지숍에서 마사지사가 자기 옆에있는 고객 몸을 계속 쳐다볼줄은 몰랐거든요.
마사지가 거의 끝날때쯤 압이 세서 너무 아파 고개를 올리고 알았어요. 저랑 눈이 마주친 이후에도 그때만 잠시 안보다가 어김없이 계속 쳐다봤어요. 가슴을 보다가 가슴을 가리면 팬티를 보고, 손마사지를 해야해서 가슴 가리던 손을 떼면 가슴을 보고.
너무나 불쾌했습니다. 처음부터 알아챘다면 마사지 도중 나갔을거에요.
reviews.textTranslated:
The male masseur continuously stared at my breasts and underwear.

We went for a foot massage today as a couple.

A female masseur treated me, while a male masseur with a mustache and beard treated my boyfriend.

It was hot, so I wore a sleeveless dress. When I stretched my legs upward to receive the massage, "the male masseur kept staring at my underwear."

At first, I didn't realize it. I never imagined that a masseur at a massage shop, where I was paying for a massage, would keep staring at the body of the customer next to him.

Towards the end of the massage, the pressure was so strong that it hurt so much that I looked up and realized it. Even after our eyes met, he didn't look for a moment, but then he continued to stare without fail. He would look at my breasts, then when I covered them, he would look at my underwear; and when I removed my hand to perform a hand massage, he would look at my breasts again.

It was extremely unpleasant. If I had noticed from the beginning, I would have walked out in the middle of the massage.

reviews.name: Marian Caballero Fidalgo
reviews.text:
Pongo una estrella porque no se puede poner menos. Mi pareja y yo acudimos a este lugar para darnos unos masajes: él de espalda y hombros y yo de cabeza, y la experiencia fue absolutamente decepcionante.
En el masaje de espalda y hombros, empaparon a mi pareja en aceite de forma exagerada, hasta el punto de estropear completamente su pantalón, que quedó lleno de manchas (como se puede ver en las fotos). Al comunicarlo al personal para buscar una solución, su respuesta fue que lo laváramos nosotros, sin asumir ninguna responsabilidad ni ofrecernos siquiera una disculpa.
En cuanto a mi masaje de cabeza, la experiencia fue igual de desagradable. Me taparon los ojos con un trapo con olor a rancio, acorde con el mal olor general del local. Durante todo el masaje, la masajista no dejó de hablar y reírse con otras empleadas, haciendo imposible cualquier intento de relajación. Para colmo, gran parte del masaje lo realizó solo con una mano, cambiando a la otra cuando se cansaba. He recibido muchos masajes en Tailandia y nunca había vivido algo así.
En resumen, un servicio poco profesional, sin atención al cliente ni respeto por quienes pagan. No recomendaría este sitio bajo ningún concepto y espero que nuestra reseña sirva para evitar que otras personas pasen por una experiencia tan mala como la nuestra.
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less. My partner and I went to this place for massages: he had a back and shoulder massage, and I had a head massage, and the experience was absolutely disappointing.
During the back and shoulder massage, they soaked my partner in oil excessively, to the point of completely ruining his trousers, which were covered in stains (as you can see in the photos). When we told the staff to find a solution, their response was that we should wash them ourselves, without taking any responsibility or even offering an apology.
As for my head massage, the experience was just as unpleasant. They covered my eyes with a musty-smelling cloth, matching the general bad smell of the place. Throughout the entire massage, the masseuse kept talking and laughing with other employees, making any attempt at relaxation impossible. To top it all off, she performed most of the massage with only one hand, switching to the other when she got tired. I've had many massages in Thailand, and I've never experienced anything like this.

In short, unprofessional service, with no customer service and no respect for those who pay. I would not recommend this place under any circumstances, and I hope our review helps prevent others from having such a bad experience as ours.

reviews.name: НатусЯ НатусЯ
reviews.text:
Хочу висловити щиру вдячність цьому салону за чудовий досвід масажу.

Окремо хочу відзначити майстра Кіту — вона зробила масаж просто неймовірним: дуже професійно, з відчуттям кожного м’яза, і водночас максимально делікатно та турботливо. Після сеансу відчувається повне розслаблення і легкість у тілі.

Сам салон залишає дуже приємне враження: чисто, спокійна атмосфера, уважний персонал.

Щиро рекомендую це місце всім, хто хоче справжній якісний масаж і відпочинок для тіла та душі. Обов’язково повернуся ще.
reviews.textTranslated:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to this salon for the wonderful massage experience.

I would like to specially mention the master Kita - she did an incredible massage: very professionally, feeling every muscle, and at the same time as delicately and caringly as possible. After the session, you feel complete relaxation and lightness in your body.

The salon itself leaves a very pleasant impression: clean, calm atmosphere, attentive staff.

I sincerely recommend this place to everyone who wants a real quality massage and relaxation for body and soul. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.text:
I visited before noon on 8 July. I intended to visit a competitor, but when I walked past this place, three attractive ladies waved to me to come inside. I asked do they accept American Express, and one lady said yes. They handed me a treatment card, and I chose body scrub with aromatherapy oil body massage for 1.5 hrs for 1000 Baht.

My masseuse Amy (or Ainy) took great care of me. She is thin and light, so I thought it would be a gentle massage. I was wrong. She put her frame into it and, while I wouldn't call it the firmest massage ever, it was not light, so it was a good fit for me. The scrub that came first was brisk, and honestly my skin is more soft than I'm comfortable admitting.

After the scrub, Amy told me to hit the showers, which was inside our private room on the third floor. The massage table had a face hole, but had a fitted sheet over it. So I was provided a pillow instead, which was acceptable but not optimal. Also, the AC in my room was off and it was hot when I first got there. But once I got oil all over me, I was cold just from the fan, even covered with a towel. There was no aggressive upselling and I left there with no stress once the service was completed.

Back downstairs I learned they do NOT accept Amex, but will take Visa for a 3% fee. Overall I had an excellent experience, and I'd be happy to return.

reviews.textTranslated:
I went there today, and personally, having been there a few years ago, it's changed quite a bit.

The place is the same, and as far as I remember, the manager is too.
He's still very friendly, attentive to explanations, and answers all questions.
I asked him for a four-handed massage and confirmed I could choose my two masseurs, which he agreed to.
1700 baht for a sesame scrub and massage, two hours in total.
And then four masseurs approached me, all about as motivated to do their job as I was about to jump off a bridge. Anyway, I chose two people, and he informed me of the tipping conditions, which I accepted. I paid for my service and was invited to join my masseurs in the treatment room.
They performed the scrub, and I specified twice that I wanted a gentle massage and therefore a mild scrub, and informed them that I didn't want anything too intense.
It's like talking to someone who is hard of hearing. I went to take a shower and came back for my massage after the scrub.
I reiterated my demands regarding the massage process, but apparently they completely ignored my complaints.
It was a very bad experience.
I do not recommend it.
I will not repeat this experience on my next trip to Chiang Mai.
I wouldn't wish it on anyone, but don't complain about a drop in business if you don't take customer feedback into account.
Finally, I informed the manager, who showed absolutely no customer service. My advice: only go if you have no expectations.

reviews.name: Emj Cast*l
reviews.text:
A Wonderful Pampering Experience at Chalong Thai Massage – Great Service, Amazing Results and Excellent Value! 💆‍♀️💅🦶(If you don’t mind whispers and their funny chats)

I had the 2.5-hour Whole Body Restoration package, and what an amazing experience it was! I ended up extending my pampering time to around 5 hours or even more because I decided to treat myself to extra services. 😂 My poor partner had to wait a few more hours than expected, but I was enjoying myself far too much to rush!

The experience started with a relaxing full-body massage, followed by a 30-minute foot scrub that worked wonders on my stubborn calluses. I was genuinely impressed with how thoroughly the therapist worked on my feet. My feet felt so much smoother afterwards, and I was very happy with the results.

I also had a manicure 💅 and pedicure, which made the whole experience even better. The staff member who looked after me was friendly, attentive and thorough. The service felt personal, and I never felt rushed. She took her time to do a good job, and I left feeling relaxed, refreshed and very satisfied.

I usually prefer Chinese massage back home in Sydney because I have a good one close to home, so I haven’t really been looking for Thai massage there. However, after this experience in Chalong, I have to say that the therapist did a fantastic job! It was a lovely surprise, and I would happily come back again when I visit Chalong in the future.

The pricing is another big plus! The package and additional treatments offer excellent value for money. Honestly, the prices are hard to compare with what we pay back home in Sydney, where appointments can feel a little rushed when everyone is trying to fit into a busy schedule.

Here in Chalong Thai Massage, I felt well looked after and could enjoy my treatments at my own pace. It was wonderful to have the time to relax, take care of myself and enjoy every part of the experience without constantly watching the clock.

If you’re visiting Chalong, Thailand, and looking for an affordable massage, foot scrub, manicure and pedicure with friendly service, I would definitely recommend giving this place a try.

Five stars from me! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great service, a lovely therapist, thorough treatments, happy feet and excellent value for money. I walked in for a few hours of pampering and practically turned it into a full-day spa retreat! 😂 Also reminded me that I left my wallet in the cashier.

Thank you, Chalong Thai Massage, for such a wonderful experience. I’ll definitely keep you in mind for my next visit! ❤️

reviews.textTranslated:
-Me: Nak Nak please

-Massage Therapist: Okay

Smiling because it was too weak

-Me: Nak Nak please

-Massage Therapist: After muttering a few words, she suddenly started pressing a wooden stick all over the bones of my foot, as if she were going to break them.

I endured it for as long as I could, so I pulled my foot away.

She asked why I kept asking her to work harder when she doesn't have the strength. I replied that I asked her to use her hands to work hard, but asked how she could use a wooden stick like that. She said she used the stick because I asked her to work hard and she didn't have the strength. Meanwhile, she kept yelling at me, asking why I kept asking for harder.

I said I wouldn't do it anymore and asked where the boss was and what her name was. Instead, she yelled back and confidently said her name was 'Aemi'.

This is my 10th trip to Thailand, and I'm a massage enthusiast who gets two massages a day, but I've truly never met a massage therapist like this in my life.

Yesterday I got a massage at Kata Noi Massage, and today, since Kata Noi Massage was fully booked, I went to Tuta Massage, which had some reviews from Koreans, and... I just got into a terrible ordeal.

(I thought some of you might be curious, so regarding Kata Noi Massage, first of all, it is much cleaner than Tuta, and the owner keeps things pleasant. However, the quality of the massage depends on the masseuse's skill. Yesterday was really refreshing, but today was just so-so... After seeing that mess at Tuta, I came back to Kata Noi and found a spot to get a massage... Sigh.)

I hope anyone reading this review absolutely, positively does not go to Tuta Massage.

I heard the owner is in Phuket Town; I wonder if the owner even knows that the staff is behaving like this.

As for the facilities... ugh... what can I even say?

You ask if there isn't a 0-star option?

Seriously, it completely ruined my mood on my last day.

reviews.name: Brinda Govindarajan
reviews.text:
We recently experienced Yam Khang Massage at Anantara Resort Chiang Mai with high hopes, but unfortunately our experience fell short of expectations. While the concept of an outdoor massage amidst nature is lovely, the location overlooking guest rooms steals privacy, the swimming pool filled with kids screaming and a wedding area blaring loud music made it challenging to relax and enjoy from the peaceful ambiance we were seeking.

This unique foot massage technique demands a high level of skill and practice. Specifically, I felt that my therapist lacked the finesse and experience required for it. The pressure and strokes were uneven, it didn't quite meet my expectations. In contrast, my husband was very pleased with his therapist’s massage skill.

To conclude, both of us couldn't fully enjoy the experience due to the environment. Perhaps considering a more secluded or soundproof area would enhance the overall experience and credit this rare, ancient Lanna Thai fire massage, where therapists use their feet dipped in herbal oil to massage, to relax and rejuvenate the muscles. We appreciate the effort and courtesy of the staff and hope these suggestions are helpful for future improvements.

Thank you very much for your lovely review.
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our spa facilities and that our team left such a wonderful impression on you.

Arnaud Béril
Cluster General Manager

reviews.name: Kylia West
reviews.text: The hostpitality at Anantara is unmatched. This was my first experience with Thai massage. They graciously explained the process to me, welcomed us with iced lemongrass tea and gave us hot ginger tea after the massage. The room is spacious and beautifully serene. They gave us cotton clothing to put on for the massage. I recommend that anyone plus size wear a stretchy jumpsuit of sweats because  the Thai sizes are small. The massage starts with a foot scrub and wash and then you are covered with towels for the massage. Bea was truly wonderful! The stretching and body weight pressure of a Thai massage gave my neck real relief unlike sweedish massages have in the past.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Kylia,

Thank you very much for sharing such a thoughtful and detailed review, along with your lovely photos. We are delighted to hear that your first experience with Thai massage was memorable and that our team made you feel welcomed and well taken care of from the moment you arrived.

It is wonderful to know that you enjoyed our herbal welcome drinks, the serene treatment room, and the traditional Thai massage rituals starting with the foot scrub. We are especially pleased to hear that Bea provided you with such excellent care and that the stretching and pressure techniques offered real relief for your neck.

Your helpful tip regarding attire for plus-size guests is greatly appreciated and will certainly benefit future visitors.

Thank you once again for choosing Anantara Spa. We hope to welcome you back for another deeply relaxing and rejuvenating experience.

Warm regards,
Arnaud Béril
Cluster General Manager

reviews.text:
這次在普吉島遇到一次非常不愉快的按摩經驗，想提醒大家多加注意。

原本我是走進去詢問「泰式指壓」，店家當下也確認是傳統的泰式按摩，價格也合理。但一開始按摩不到兩分鐘，按摩師就直接塗上精油，完全沒說明，等於強行改成了「精油按摩」。結束後才告知是油壓價錢，費用直接翻倍，讓人覺得被惡意誤導、甚至是強迫消費。

不僅如此，按摩師的手法也非常不專業，按壓沒有節奏、毫無技巧可言，過程中只是隨意搓揉，完全感受不到放鬆，反而讓人更加不舒服。

整體來說，這是一家黑心店家，誠信有問題、技術也不專業。如果你到普吉島想按摩，務必要特別小心這類手法不清、價格不透明的店家，避免和我一樣被坑。
reviews.textTranslated:
I had a very unpleasant massage experience in Phuket and want to warn others to be careful.

I went in to inquire about "Thai acupressure," and the shop confirmed it was a traditional Thai massage at a reasonable price. However, less than two minutes into the massage, the masseuse applied essential oils without explanation, essentially turning it into an "oil massage." Only after it was over did they tell me it was an oil massage, doubling the price, making me feel maliciously misled and even forced to buy.

Furthermore, the masseuse's technique was extremely unprofessional. The pressure lacked rhythm and skill; the massage was just random rubbing, offering no relaxation whatsoever and making me feel even more uncomfortable.

Overall, this is a dishonest business with questionable integrity and unprofessional skills. If you're in Phuket and want a massage, be extremely careful of shops with unclear techniques and opaque pricing to avoid being ripped off like I was.

reviews.name: Jeffrey Ta
reviews.text:
這家店誠信令人質疑，原本說好是泰式指壓服務，卻未事先告知收取的是泰式油壓的費用，讓人感到非常失望。提醒大家務必提高警覺，別再因此上當受騙、白白花錢。也希望這樣的黑心店能早日被市場淘汰。

This shop’s integrity is highly questionable. J ai mis fin au massage à cause de la douleur et la masseuse s est mise à me manquer de respect en commençant à crier que c était de ma faute. Expérience épouvantable, aucune écoute, à fuir !!!
reviews.textTranslated:
Avoid at all costs!!! GO AWAY!!!

I asked for a shoulder and head massage. The masseuse started climbing on top of me, pressing on my legs and back until my back cracked.
After I told her that this wasn't what I had asked for and that it was really hurting me, she got angry and literally attacked my shoulders with a repetitive motion, pouring half a bottle of oil over them. I told her again that it hurt, so she tried to hold my neck down, insisting that I had a problem in that area. I ended the massage because of the pain, and the masseuse started being disrespectful, yelling that it was my fault. She stormed out, shouting in Thai throughout the entire center.

Awful experience, no one listened, avoid at all costs!!!

The worst massage place I have ever experienced.
The employees were constantly talking and laughing during the massage, showing no professionalism or attention to the customer. The therapist applied pressure in completely inappropriate places and seemed more focused on chatting with the employee next to her than on the massage itself.
At one point, while talking to her colleague, she kept pressing her elbow hard into my shoulder for several minutes, which left me with a large hematoma. I tried to tell her that it was painful and to stop, but she simply laughed.
The place itself is also huge, crowded, and extremely noisy. Many people are receiving massages at the same time, with very little privacy or consideration for the customer's comfort. It feels more like a noisy production line than a relaxing massage experience.
Overall, this was not only the worst massage I have ever had, but also an unpleasant and potentially unsafe experience. Stay away if you value your health, comfort, and privacy.
